I’m really happy I chose this place and would definitely recommend it to anyone who wants to learn barista skills in a positive and supportive environment. ||| Visit to Nepal’s First SCA-Certified “Kaidako Coffee”, A Disappointing Specialty Coffee Experience

Yesterday, I had the opportunity to visit Kaidako Coffee, Nepal’s first SCA-certified coffee shop, also known as NCA Nepal Coffee Academy, run by Dr. Raj Kumar Banjara. Given Dr. Banjara’s significant contributions to the coffee industry and his active role in promoting coffee education, I had high expectations for both the product and the service.

However, the overall experience fell well short of what one would expect from a specialty coffee establishment.

Upon entering the café, we were surprised that there was no acknowledgment or greeting from the staff. When we inquired about terrace seating, we were told it wasn’t available, so we settled at a two-seater table inside. We waited for a while until the barista approached us with the menu, but even then, there was no basic greeting. This lack of warmth or hospitality was our first red flag.

I noticed French Press for two people listed at NPR 300 on the menu. I asked the barista if I could get it served with milk on the side, which is a fairly common request. He hesitated and said he would check with his “Sir.” He returned shortly to inform us, “We don’t do that.” There was no explanation or flexibility, a disappointing response from a place that claims to be part of the specialty coffee scene, where personalization and education are supposed to be key.

I decided to proceed with a single-serving French Press. I also asked if they had any food pairing options for the coffee, perhaps some bakery items. Unfortunately, they had nothing except croissants and a few cookies. I asked specifically for dark chocolate cookies, but they were not available either.

Meanwhile, my friend ordered a Peach Iced Tea with less ice and a plate of Chicken Mo:Mo.

The Peach Iced Tea arrived within 5 minutes, but ironically, with no ice at all. The Chicken Mo:Mo came about 15 minutes later, and my French Press coffee arrived roughly 2 minutes after that. To my surprise, the so-called “French Press” wasn’t served in a French Press pot or server at all, but rather poured directly into a handle-less glass cup. The cup was too hot to hold, and no consideration seemed to be given to customer safety or presentation. This kind of oversight is particularly troubling for a place claiming to follow Specialty Coffee Association (SCA) standards.

The Chicken Mo:Mo was decent in taste, nothing extraordinary, but enjoyable. The coffee was just okay, though I couldn’t fully evaluate the flavor profile, as I had already eaten Mo:Mo before the coffee. As for water, we were served detox water after we had finished our food and drinks, which again shows a lack of attention to basic service sequence.

When we went to pay the bill, things got even more confusing. I was charged for the French Press at the full rate of NPR 300, despite having only one cup instead of the two-person serving as stated on the menu. No explanation or clarification was provided, and to top it off, no receipt was given.

My overall experience at Kaidako Coffee was deeply underwhelming. Despite the establishment being run by one of Nepal’s leading coffee professionals and educators, the service was disorganized, the hospitality lacking, and the basic standards of specialty coffee service were not met. From improper presentation to poor customer engagement and billing confusion, the café failed to deliver on the promises associated with the Specialty Coffee Association label.

If Kaidako Coffee wants to live up to its name and reputation, especially while running an academy that trains others in the craft, it needs a serious reevaluation of its SOPs, staff training, and customer experience protocols.

Tucked away just off a busy street in Thamel, Norling Tibetan Restaurant felt like a little pocket of calm. There is no pretense here, just good food and people coming together over bowls of something warm.

The soup was the highlight for me. It looked creamy and almost milky, but the server assured me there was no milk in it. The richness comes from long simmered grains and bones. It had a soothing, almost nostalgic feel to it, like something you would crave on a cold day in the mountains.

What makes it even more meaningful is the history behind places like Norling. After the Tibetan uprising in 1959, many Tibetans fled into Nepal and settled in areas like Boudhanath and Swayambhu. With them came not only their spiritual traditions but also their food. Over time, Tibetan restaurants became community hubs where refugees found a taste of home and curious visitors like me could experience Tibetan culture through its flavors.

Kathmandu’s Tibetan restaurants are more than just places to eat. They are part of a living story about migration, survival, and cultural connection. Even if you are just stopping by for a bowl of soup or a plate of momo, you are becoming part of that story.

We are very very serious about our vegeterain food choice and this dalle served us chicken wonton which is pathetic.

At the end all they said was SORRY. Obviously that sorry wouldn’t compensate our emotions.

We left from there without eating anything and won’t ever come back to this place again. ||| I ordered from Dalle via Pathao, and the experience was disappointing:
Alu Nimki: The taste was overly sour (amilo) and not enjoyable. Not worth the price.
Veg Momo: The filling was extremely chopped up (dhulo jasto) with no proper texture or taste.

However, the pricing feels a bit on the higher side compared to similar offerings in the area.

Food was excellent. I ate there 2 times during my short stay in Thamel Nepal and very nice staff and great food and service for a low cost. The food was delicious and the space was impressively clean. While the service was a little slow, the roadside views and easy parking made the wait much better. Definitely worth a visit for a tasty meal! 🇰🇷✨ ||| The best kimchijjigye in Nepal even better than the ones in Korea. I am from South Korea and I can tell that normally Nepali people make excellent kimchi. But here it was absolutely the best. These days, kimchi in Korea is becoming too sweet and tasteless so Kimch in Nepal tastes more traditional. How ironic😉 Please try their Kimchjjigye especially after long trekking. 김치찌개 꼭 드셔보세요. 한국보다 맛있어요👍🏻😍 ||| The ambience was pleasant and comfortable. The serving time was reasonable, with no long wait. The gimbap stood out and tasted really good. The tteokbokki was decent, though nothing special. Overall, it was an okay experience. ||| I’m sorry to say that my experience at Bibimbap Korean Restaurant was quite disappointing. I ordered the Jjajangmyeon, as it looked very appealing in the pictures, but unfortunately the taste did not meet expectations. The dish was pale, lacked flavor, and the noodles even had an unpleasant smell. When I mentioned this to the waiter, I was told that the food “always tastes the same,” which made me feel even more disheartened.

I still paid the bill without making a fuss, but I truly regretted the visit. Hopefully, the restaurant can improve on the quality and taste of this dish in the future. ||| Same here a few times. The spicy pork with gochujung and sauce is very good served with plenty of fresh lettuce, tanjung, sliced garlic, and kimchi. The banchon doesn’t have proper Korean namul, but maybe they can’t get the vegetables here?  They make the chicken dish with sliced breast meat and not chicken thighs, so it’s dry and not recommended.

address: Paknajol, Near, Saat Ghumthi Near, Kathmandu 44600, Nepal
reviews:
Visited this amazing vegan place during our trip to Kathmandu and absolutely loved it! The menu had so many options that we couldn’t resist and it was so good that we went back again the very next day before leaving.
We ordered a wide variety of dishes from pizzas, bruschettas, burrito wraps and sandwiches to beverages, energy balls, and ice creams. Everything was 100% vegan.
Our personal favorites were the pizzas (a must try) and the spiced grilled pineapple ice cream, so unique and flavorful! The date ice cream and even the oreo ice cream were incredibly delicious.
Every single item was perfectly balanced in terms of flavors, fresh and thoughtfully prepared. One can truly taste the quality and creativity in each dish. ||| I found this place by googling vegan western food - after trekking to Everest basecamp - I was craving some good quality wider variety food.
I then visited every day for the 5 nights I stayed in Katmandu.
Delicious food, good value and nice staff.
The only thing I would prefer would be if the beautiful courtyard was non-smoking. ||| ⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐

I recently visited **ALWAYS HAPPY FOOD – Veg & Vegan Restaurant**, and it was truly a wonderful experience from start to finish. We ordered a wide variety of dishes, including Veg Momos, Jhol Momos, Veg Thukpa, Farmhouse Veggie Pizza, Mexican Black Beans Rice Wrap, Veg Kadai, Paneer Kadai, Dal Tadka, Rice, Veg Biryani, Sizzling Brownie, and Lemon Tart — and I can honestly say that **each and every item was exceptionally good**. The flavors were well balanced, the food was fresh, and the presentation was impressive.

What really stood out was the hospitality. The staff and the owners were extremely warm, polite, and attentive, making sure we were comfortable and well taken care of throughout our visit. Their friendly service added a personal touch that made the experience even more enjoyable.

The restaurant has a lovely, calm, and welcoming ambiance, perfect for dining with family or friends. The cleanliness and overall vibe make it a great place to relax and enjoy good food.

If you are in Nepal and looking for high-quality vegetarian and vegan food with excellent service and a pleasant atmosphere, **ALWAYS HAPPY FOOD** is definitely worth visiting. Highly recommended! ||| I recently visited this vegetarian/Vegan Restaurant and had a really satisfying experience. I had naan and Panner curry for dinner here, The naan was soft, warm, and freshly made—exactly how it should be. The paneer curry was rich, flavorful, and well-balanced with spices.

Overall, the food felt fresh, well-prepared, and satisfying without being too heavy. The combination of different cuisines worked well, and everything tasted authentic in its own way. I’d definitely recommend this place to anyone looking for good vegetarian food with a bit of variety. ||| I decided to give this place a try given its high ratings, so expectations were naturally quite high. Unfortunately, the experience fell below what I had anticipated, mainly due to the food quality.

The dry noodles were, honestly, the driest I’ve ever had—almost like a clump of over-drained noodles topped with very dry minced meat that lacked any moisture or sauce. I had to add quite a bit of chilli oil just to make it more palatable.

The acai bowl/salad bowl was also a bit disappointing. It was served at room temperature, almost slightly warm, whereas we were expecting something chilled—especially after a long walk under the sun.

The pizza was decent. The dough was nicely baked and enjoyable, but the cheese felt a bit light and not as flavourful as expected. This could also come down to personal preference, especially if you’re used to stronger flavours.
Overall, it might just be my experience, but based on this visit, it’s not a place I would revisit.

A good place for a quick bite. ||| Momo was very very bad.
Improve your momo quality. ||| Nice new opened restaurant ,check it out guys. ||| Nice 👍 ||| its nice place

Came to Tasala every night  of our visit to Kathmandu! The staff were very attentive to our dietary requirements and answered any questions we had. Delicious food - we had the buff bara, chicken chatamari and chicken khaja set. Would recommend if you’re looking for a great meal and great price! ||| Tasala is an absolute gem when it comes to serving delicious momos and sizzlers. As a food enthusiast, I am always on the lookout for places that offer exceptional taste without breaking the bank, and Tasala has exceeded my expectations in every way.
The ambiance at Tasala is warm and inviting, perfect for a casual meal with friends or a cozy dinner with loved ones ||| I found it above good. Nice setup. Lights, english books just side by your table, peaceful..... i enjoyed. Me and my friends gathered for the first time after covid lockdown here and tried momos and lemon tea. Momo was average. Price ? Price i think is okay for occasion visit. ||| Loved the food!! Jhol momo was so yummy!! Cozy place with reasonable price!!! Must go... ||| Overall food and drinks was good.
But sisha lil disappointed me .

address: P876+V97 Tourism, Paryatan Marg, Kathmandu 44600, Nepal
reviews: Incredible steak with béarnaise sauce when I was here! It comes out of the kitchen sizzling and they made it promptly after the order. Plenty of options on the menu and my friends loved their meals as well! The Surf and Turf, New York style, and others are all great! ||| Had a very nice dinner here! Good steak with a spectacular sizzling appearance! The waiter was very friendly and the service was exceptionally quick. The deep fried apple momo’s definitely are the perfect way to end your meal. Good prices too. Make sure you go here when you’re in Thamel :). ||| Little bit of a fancier food experience here in Kathmandu but very worth the price ||| What a gem! Great place for a hearty meal post trek. The food is exceptional, and very reasonably priced. The staff are very knowledgeable and give good suggestions. I can definitely recommend the steak with bernaise sauce and the banana and rum pancakes. Delicious! ||| Steak was supposed to be fillet, but it is not. I asked the sauce on the side in order to taste the steak itself. So… not. Better to have hamburger in this city. And if you eat here, please ask the steak not in sizzling plate.

address: 2nd floor Durbar Mall, Durbar Marg, Kathmandu 44600, Nepal
reviews:
Yasumi is truly a unique and extraordinary place with a beautifully curated atmosphere that stands out from other restaurants. The ambiance and overall concept make it a memorable destination. The service was decent, though it could be more attentive. While the presentation was appealing, the food did not quite meet expectations considering the price point. A lovely place to visit for the experience, but there is room for improvement in both the food quality and value. ||| I recently visited to check out the ambience, which has a nice Japanese-inspired aesthetic. The standout feature is the unique seating area where you can submerge your feet in water with fish. However, there are only four tables available for this experience; even though the rest of the restaurant was practically empty during my visit, we weren't able to secure one of those spots. Also, keep in mind that the temperature in the dining area is kept a bit higher, likely to accommodate the fish.

Regarding the food, we ordered the Salmon & Avocado sushi roll (NRs 1650) and the Shogayaki Bento Box (NRs 1350). The bento box was well-prepared and felt worth the price. However, I found the sushi roll to be quite expensive considering it only came with four pieces.

Overall, it’s a unique spot for the atmosphere, but I’d suggest being mindful of the menu pricing for certain items. ||| Amazing place to try Japanese Cuisine. The staffs are so polite and the food is amazing too. Good place for occasional meal.

You can enter the pool with fishes too for free.. ||| Our family tried Japanese cuisine for the first time, and we had a wonderful experience. The food was delicious, the service was excellent, and the staff were very friendly and welcoming. The ambiance was warm,relaxing and beautifully designed. We thoroughly enjoyed our visit and would highly recommend this restaurant to anyone looking for an authentic and memorable dining experience😊 ||| This is my first experience in Japanese Restaurant and I must say its good experience. The interior was cozy and nice. Best part will be the sitting area on fish pool. You can enjoy your food while fishes will play with your feet 😊👍. Overall all foods are tasty and its must visit for once to feel Japanese look and feel. You can also try pure Japanese drinks like Sake Maru etc. all staffs are cooperative and attentive.

restaurant_name: Lazeez Biryani house and restaurant sundhara
address: Sundhara near global ime bank, near mumbai zaika, काठमाडौँ 44600, Nepal
reviews: Best biryani in town ||| It's a small halal restaurant, located in basement and bit difficult to find. At first glance, I was bit skeptical about the restaurant, but when I tried the food, I was quite satisfied. The place has good biryani. The food is good and the place looked quite clean. I have tried many biryani places and this is one of the best. I would definitely recommend this place if you are looking for halal biryani place.

We had a great time here. Lucky us we got to experience live music. They’ve got live music on Friday’s and Saturdays. The food was amazing especially Kodo Nachos was Muwahhhhh😘. I definitely will be visiting again also thank you so much team for making the experience beautiful. ||| Ambience was exceptional. Comparing to view service and quality of food are nothing. I felt like some staffs are not professional (not all). Price of food was really expensive despite if its quality.  Only this good thing is view of Dharahara. ||| Sometimes, the best experiences begin with the simplest moments. For days, we’d seen Kiran enthusiastically inviting people from the street to visit Dharahara Garden Restaurant. His energy was infectious, and one day, curiosity got the best of us — we finally decided to go. And wow, we’re so glad we did.

Nestled in a peaceful corner, Dharahara Garden Restaurant is a true oasis in the middle of the city. The ambiance is absolutely beautiful — lush greenery, soft lighting, and a calm atmosphere that instantly makes you feel relaxed and welcome. Whether you’re looking for a quiet meal or a lively gathering, this place suits every mood.

The food? Far better than we ever expected. Every dish was flavorful, fresh, and clearly made with care. From local favorites to more adventurous bites, the menu didn’t disappoint.

But what truly elevated our experience was the warmth of the staff. Our servers, Sunil and Gyanendra, were exceptional — attentive without being overbearing, always smiling, and genuinely passionate about providing a great dining experience. It’s rare to come across such sincere service.

Dharahara Garden Restaurant isn’t just a place to eat — it’s a place to enjoy, unwind, and feel at home. A big thank you to Kiran for calling us in — he led us to something special. Highly recommended to anyone looking for more than just a meal. ||| Amazing atmosphere And Dharahara Garden Restaurant is a place with a suitable environment for eating, drinking, and sitting while enjoying the view of Dharahara. Don't forget to go. ||| Today I ordered 5 bottle of sprite and got 5 bottles of coke. Ordered 1 veg chowmein and got chicken chowmen without even mentioning it was chicken. Somosa chat was so sour, seems like the bottle slipped from hand while pouring. All this happened in a single order. Would you believe??!

This place had declined so much in quality that I don't think I will return back ever. Place hasn't been renovated in years. Washroom was filthy. Service was good though. Food were just average. There is no parking space. Their Special dish "Tiger Chicken" was laughable. Nothing special about that dish. Please never order it. Momo was just average. Hot chocolate tasted like Nestle boost drink. Coffee was just ok. Avoit it and go somewhere else. ||| Awesome 👍👍👍 all things r good as u wish... specially food items... ||| The momo in this place is sth different sth that melts like butter in the mouth so when u visit place don't forget to order the chicken momo u will love it ||| Expensive for what it's worth, not great food, and not good enough service, never liked places which can't even provide a glass of drinking water.
And a bottle is 50rs. ||| Had momo, pizza, chicken Tanduri, American choosey.
Triangular Momo was great 5 out of 5.
American chopsuey was good 3.5 out 5.
N about the pizza for even try. This place is not for pizza. Cheese had awful smell n the dough I think it was bought from departmental store. For some reason this restaurant doesnt serves pork and buff dish,only goat and chicken item and menu. Good for Nepalese and Indian quisine
Place is good ,, but i didn't find the services worth it . ||| U can get delicious recipes and good parking space ||| Good food good service ||| Not so good one ||| Not a good place.

restaurant_name: The Black Gold Restaurant: Halal Authentic
reviews:
I had a Birthday Function Today at this restaurant. From the moment I walked in, the ambiance was warm, clean, and welcoming. The staff were extremely polite, attentive, and professional, Specially A Guy , I forgot his full name, He also give us discount on our bill and he makes sure we felt comfortable throughout our visit.

The Mutton Mandi and Chicken Tikka Masala was absolutely delicious—fresh, well-presented, and full of flavor. Each dish was prepared with great attention to detail, and the portion sizes were perfect. I especially appreciated how quickly the food was served without compromising on quality.

Overall, this restaurant offers excellent service, amazing food, and a pleasant atmosphere. It’s the perfect place for family gatherings, casual dining, or even special occasions. Highly recommended, and I’ll definitely be coming back again❤️

Badhi Khushi Huwi Hamko ❤️
Thank you nepal & Thank you Blackgold ! ||| Good food. Attentive staff.
Had chicken briyani. Taste is good, sufficient spices and well cooked.

The only drawback is only 1 table proper to have meal. The other two tables good for coffee, snacking and dessert as they are a bit low.
They also have an area for Majlis... Sitting down like those in West Asia. ||| I had a great experience at The Black Gold in Durbar Marg. The food was flavorful and well-prepared, with a solid variety of halal options. The meat was tender and clearly high quality, and everything tasted fresh. The atmosphere is modern and comfortable, making it a nice spot to relax or meet friends. Service was also friendly and efficient. Definitely worth a visit if you’re looking for good halal food in Kathmandu. ||| One of the finest Halal food restaurant at the heart of kathmandu. Serving amazingly delicious Arabic & indian halal cusine. Bar BQ items were very tasty & delicious . Meat was tender juicy & blend of spices was immaculous. Loved the ambiance & soft music hitting the heart. Great Place for families & short meetings. ||| This is the place to try the best Arab food in Kathmandu. Specially when you are in Durbarmarg area and area searching for Halal foods with Arab Indo Fusion, you must try this place. I went there with skeptic mind but this place turned me out to be their fan with proper Arabic Style Ambience, cleanliness and see through kitchen which made me confident about the cleanliness. The restroom was also clean and talking about the food; masallah❤️

address: Exact Opposite to Kathmandu ENT Hospital, 28 अद्वैत मार्ग, काठमाडौँ 44600, Nepal
reviews:
As a regular customer of Syanko & Multicuisine Restaurant, I can proudly say it’s one of those places that feels like a second home. Whether you want a cup of warm tea or a full meal, this restaurant has all types of food, served with consistent quality.

The vibe here is always refreshing—good music, a calm atmosphere, and a welcoming environment that makes you want to stay longer. Every visit feels special because of the people who work here. Swikar dai and Jeni didi make the experience even better with their friendly behavior, quick service, and warm hospitality.

If you're looking for a place with great food, good music, and people who truly care about their customers, Syanko & Multicuisine Restaurant is the perfect spot. ||| Syanko & Multicuisine Restaurant is one of those places you instantly feel comfortable in. I’m not a regular like some people, but every time I visit, I understand why people come back again and again. The restaurant offers all types of dishes, each prepared with great taste and freshness. Even something as simple as a cup of tea feels special here.

The atmosphere is warm and lively, with good music playing in the background that sets the perfect mood for relaxing or chatting with friends. But what truly stands out is the staff. Swikar dai and Jeni didi treat every customer with genuine respect and friendliness, making you feel valued the moment you walk in.

Whether you’re here for a quick tea or a full meal, Syanko & Multicuisine Restaurant gives you a complete experience—good food, good vibe, and even better people. ||| Pizza Hawaii was tasty. My friend tried also burger and sendwich and was excited. The service was very nice, the restaurant is nice and clean.  We felt comfortable here.  I recommend :) ||| Coffee was good, but the sandwich portion felt small for the price. Nice ambiance overall. ||| Awesome! New fancy restaurant with very nice staff and delicious food 🙂 one and only problem, that we found it last day. I had cheese pizza, club sandwich and crunchy chicken burger and everything was perfect.

The restaurant has a very nice ambiance, and the staffs were attentive. However, I was disappointed with the food. The menu prices are relatively high, but the food quality and taste were only average.
What concerned me even more was the billing process. When I requested the bill, I was not given an official receipt or invoice. Instead, I was handed what appeared to be an order note. For a restaurant charging premium prices, customers should be provided with a proper bill. This raises questions about transparency. Overall, the atmosphere and service were good, but the food quality and billing practices need significant improvement. ||| Absolutely loved Revolution Café! Located right in the middle of a busy roundabout, this place has such a unique and vibrant atmosphere.

The customer service was genuinely excellent, friendly, attentive, and welcoming from start to finish.

The food was amazing and full of flavor and the happy hour cocktails were a fantastic bonus.

A very pleasant spot to stop for lunch or enjoy a cold drink while watching the city life around you. Highly recommended! ||| This cafe is in great location central new road I like here all the food , staff, atmosphere, i really enjoyed here ambiance is superb, from terrace super view. I highly recommend to you all if you looking around new road good food and restaurant please visit here with your family and friends. ||| Revolution Café was busy but not overly crowded when we visited. It has a very extensive menu covering Western favourites alongside Nepali, other Asian dishes, pizzas, Mexican food, and Italian pasta. The food and drinks were good, though a little slow to arrive.

Seating is available both indoors and outdoors. The outdoor tables are right on the street and can be a bit loud, but still able to hold a conversation without issue.

Service was very friendly and welcoming.

They mentioned that vegetables and fruit are washed with mineral water and that organic ingredients are used where possible.

Cards are accepted, but there’s a 4% surcharge, so paying cash is cheaper.

Toilets are Western-style and located just outside the restaurant. ||| Do NOT trust them when it comes to drinking water.

Went there the other day and asked the person about the water being served and the person told me that it was good tap water. Nope it wasn’t. Made the stomach mad upset and felt unwell for a whole day afterwards.

Food and coffee was ok.

This restaurant is amazing!  We visited with a group of friends whilst we were in durbar square.  We all returned here after looking round the square.  Our food was ready swiftly, it was all exceptionally tasty.  The team were all very efficient, kind and helpful.

The views across Kathmandu were also fantastic.  I would definitely recommend to anyone visiting this area. ||| Heritage rooftop cafe:
The view is spectacular. The service is great. The food is good, but I find it overpriced by at least 35%. The view is really great, but it's not worth the hit to the pocket. But, having said that, I would definitely go back just to have access to that fantastic view again.
4 Stars ⭐⭐⭐⭐ ||| Great views over Kathmandu. We came here for mid afternoon snacks. The chicken pops, chili chicken, garlic naan and fried momos were tasty. Service was good although they forgot one of the dishes. ||| Lovely rooftop place that can serve as peaceful 'getaway' before or after (or in lieu of) going to Durbar Square. It's peaceful to grab a drink and some food so you can look at the square and the top of the ancient buildings. They have wide variety of options food and drinks. The staff is great to interact with and speak English. The veg Thali wasn't anything spectacular.

🌱 friendly.

2 potential concerns:
(1) 3-5 level of stairs to climb. Not ♿️ friendly and likely not your ideal place if you have issues with stairs.
(2) majority of tables sit 4 so if you are solo or couple, it might feel like you are taking up space, especially during high season. ||| Enjoy the best possible view of Basantapur Durbar Square while enjoying a wide variety of delicious food and drinks. With an extensive menu offering everything from local favorites to international dishes, there’s something to suit everyone. The drinks selection is  impressive. Along with the stunning views, the attentive and friendly service makes it a perfect spot to relax and take in the sights of Basantapur.

Perfectly located and Interior is good! Service is not worth it! Late arrival of food and the price is not reasonable! Good thing here is you
can grab a book to read while waiting! But they made us wait for a long time! To sum up, sleepy service, mediocre food for the price! ||| This restaurant is easily located near Kathmandu durbar square, Freak street. I loved their chowmein as well as special potato fries.

Updated review: service was too slow the last time I was here. When we went to the counter to pay bill, there was no one. After waiting for sometime, their staff came. Jhol momo was not that good. Jhol had more than needed vinegar taste. ||| Always a delightful atmosphere in this place. Good place to hang out or meet up friends. Toilets always clean as well. ||| Nice interior in this place. Service is not good here. Price of the food is reasonable. Our food arrived very late. Everything tasted good. ||| Falcha is a newari word. It means a place to rest after you are tired walking or traveling. This restaurant is one of those places where you can hangout with your friends after work.

Cozy place. Only indoor seating available. Nicece to go for quick bites and chitchats. Food is good, could have been better.

Food is very delicious and tasty. Good Service. Overall Excellent ||| Loved the cozy atmosphere and excellent service. The staff was polite and attentive. A perfect place to relax with friends. Will definitely visit again ||| One of the best cafe .. everything was well maintained..staff , ambience, service..food specially butter chicken ..👌loved it .wish u best of luck for future 🙏 ||| In my experience food was so delicious and service was so good I have taste chicken biryani and bubble tea was so fantastic. ||| Chicken biryani and katti roll was good and the staffs were friendly

reviews:
Absolutely love this little momo place

Food is good prices reasonable, wish there was no hookah (I hate smoking) but that's what to go orders are for I guess. ||| My 3 daughters and I went to this place near Kathmandu Durbar Square based on the good reviews in Google Map.  This place did not disappoint.  Service was good, food was good and most of all, the price was extremely reasonable.  We ate momos, keema noodles and fried rice. I wholeheartedly recommend this place.  My daughters wrote a thank-you note as in the picture. ||| Yatri Cafe in Kathmandu's Durbar Square is a hidden gem run by two friendly young ladies. Masala tea with less milk is aromatic, and the buffalo and chicken momo dishes are delicious. It's a cozy spot to relax after exploring the square ||| Really a hidden gem inside basantapur durbar square, best place to hang out with friends and family, great food, great ambience & welcoming environment, overall cheap and affordable cafe by far. ||| I got there after reading a google review. The place is in a quiet alley and the food was wonderful at reasonable prices.

Amazing food and drinks. Recommended by a local friend, we went there one night for dinner , we decided to go back the next day for lunch.

Bipana was our waitress and was amazingly friendly and gentle. Great service. ||| Great atmosphere and a perfect hangout spot for family and friends. The live music after 8:00 PM adds a nice touch, and the Chicken Jhol Momo is a must-try! Pizza was also very good .
Definitely a place I’d recommend ||| This is a wonderful busy oasis! Great food (recommend the steak burger, the chicken wings, chilly chicken and the mixed platter). The fresh pineapple juice is pricy but makes up for the price with ahuge glass. The pool table upstairs is the main reason we kept coming back but the food was the best possible bonus! ||| Great food and friendly staff.
Our waiter Manjit was lovely and looked after us very well. ||| Busy Bee is hands down one of the best pubs in town for great food, fantastic cocktails, and an unbeatable atmosphere! From the moment I walked in, I was struck by the relaxed yet energetic vibe—perfect for unwinding after a long day or kicking off a fun night out. The food was absolutely delicious, with a menu that offers something for everyone, whether you're craving hearty comfort food or something a bit more refined. And let’s talk about the cocktails—creative, well-balanced, and packed with flavor. The bartenders clearly know their craft!

What really made the experience stand out was the incredible staff. They were so friendly, attentive, and genuinely eager to make sure everyone had a great time. The customer service here is top-notch, which is always a huge plus.

But the highlight of my visit was definitely the live music. The sound system is amazing—crisp, clear, and powerful without being overwhelming. I had the chance to catch Abhaya Subba and the Steam Engines perform, and it was an unforgettable night. The energy in the room was electric, and the band sounded incredible thanks to the venue’s stellar acoustics.

Whether you're coming for the food, the drinks, the music, or just the vibe, Busy Bee delivers on all fronts. I can’t recommend this place enough and will absolutely be back for more. If you haven’t been yet, do yourself a favor and check it out—you won’t regret it!

address: P847+957 ND's Building, महाबौद्ध मार्ग, Kathmandu 44600, Nepal
reviews: Holds legacy dating back decades to its original location in Mahabouddha. This bakery was a neat and beloved spot in the capital long before today's cafe culture emerged. It still continues to serve good food at remarkably reasonable prices, and its service and old-school vibes call for repeat visits. ||| The ambiance of this place is great, with a unique, cyberpunk vibe thanks to its location in an alleyway of technical shops.  However, the food experience was a bit lacking considering the portion sizes and quality.  I ordered set 3, which cost 450 rs. There are plenty of drink options, along with their house coffee blend & brand merch for sale. There's plenty of seating available both inside & outside. ||| Date: 26th June 2025
Location: Kathmandu Coffee, Lazimpat
Purpose: Business Meeting

Upon entering Kathmandu Coffee, there was no greeting or acknowledgment from the staff. The counter was directly in front, so I approached and asked the female barista if I could dine in. She didn’t seem to understand the term, so I rephrased and asked if I could have my coffee inside. She then responded that she would bring the menu and asked me to take a seat.

After I sat down, I noticed two tables occupied with a total of four customers. The ambiance was small but clean and decent. There were visible coffee machines, merchandise, and a roasting room on the other side. The barista returned with the menu but simply placed it on the table without any verbal communication and went back behind the bar.

While going through the menu, I noticed the “Specialty Brew Coffee” section. I asked her what types of coffee they offered in that category. She mentioned “pour over.” I then asked if they offered French press, and she confirmed they did. When I inquired about bean options, she mentioned light roast beans from Gulmi and a few others. As I usually prefer dark roast, I asked if they had any. She said yes and suggested a dark roast from Ilam, which I agreed to try. However, she did not ask if I would like any food pairing with my coffee.

Shortly afterward, two male baristas entered the bar. One attended another table’s order while the other started preparing mine. Surprisingly, it took about 15 minutes just to prepare a single French press. Even more shocking was the presentation – the French press coffee was served in a V60 server, which is not appropriate for that brewing method. When I asked if it was indeed a French press, the response was simply, “Yes.”

I poured the coffee and assessed its aroma, flavor, acidity, and body. It tasted smoky, burnt, and woody, with medium acidity and body, and a lingering woody aftertaste — very different from the typical flavor profile of Ilam’s dark roast. When I shared my concerns with the barista and invited him to taste the coffee with me, he agreed with my assessment and offered to prepare a new one.

I then asked about the grind size and requested to see the ground beans. Upon inspection, the grind was uneven — a mix of fine and coarse particles, which likely contributed to the off flavor.

Just then, I received a call informing me that the meeting had shifted to another location, so I canceled the second coffee. At the counter, I paid the bill, which seemed a bit overpriced considering my dissatisfaction. No discount was offered, and I was not even provided a receipt.

Conclusion:
There was a clear lack of customer focus and service orientation. Staff appeared inadequately trained in both communication and technical aspects of coffee service. Most importantly, there was no effort to recover from a poor customer experience.

Suggestion:
Kathmandu Coffee needs to improve its emphasis on customer service, understand individual customer preferences, and ensure consistency in coffee quality. Staff should be trained to offer personalized recommendations, proper brewing methods, and handle service recovery more professionally. A great product alone is not enough, a great experience matters just as much. ||| It's basically a Coffe bar with varieties of coffee options available. address: Tribhuvan International Airport (KTM, International Terminal, काठमाडौँ 44600, Nepal
reviews:
I had to stay at the airport until around 4:00 AM, and the team at Arabica Coffee made the experience much more comfortable. The customer service was excellent, the coffee was good, and the light background music created a calm and pleasant atmosphere.

Before moving to Arabica, I was at Java Coffee since they were open until 1:30 AM (which I was not aware). Unfortunately, my experience there was not as positive. I had arrived very early, around 10:00 PM, and was sitting inside at a four-seater table while working and attending an online office meeting. When a group arrived, a staff member asked me to move to another table, even though the new guests themselves kindly suggested that they could sit elsewhere and that I should not be moved.

The music inside Java was also quite loud, making it difficult to focus on my meeting. In addition, some of the songs being played contained offensive and inappropriate language, which felt uncomfortable in an airport setting, especially while trying to work professionally. I also asked if I could sit outside in a quieter area, but was told the space was occupied, even though there appeared to be only one person sitting there at the time.

As a solo female spending the night at the airport, I greatly appreciated the welcoming, safe, and relaxed environment at Arabica Coffee. The staff were accommodating, respectful, and never made me feel uncomfortable for staying late. Thank you to the Arabica team for providing such a positive experience during a long overnight wait. ||| Had a long coffee break at Arabica Coffee & Pizzeria before my flight, and I was pleasantly surprised!

I tried the Flat White and Café Mocha — both were excellent. Smooth, well-balanced, and aromatic. The Flat White had a velvety texture and robust flavour, while the Mocha had a comforting blend of chocolate and espresso that wasn't overly sweet.

The Blueberry Cheesecake was decent, though not the highlight. The cream was a little too light and didn’t carry the rich tang of traditional cheese, but the blueberry topping was delicious and helped elevate the dessert a little.

This cafe is conveniently located just outside Kathmandu Airport. It’s a great place to unwind before or after your flight. Clean, welcoming atmosphere with friendly staff and prompt service.

Definitely worth stopping by for a good cup of coffee, even if you’re not staying for a meal. address: Dattatraya Square, Tachupal Tole, Bhaktapur 44800, Nepal
reviews:
Mayur Restaurant at Datatreya is a hidden gem in Bhaktapur. The location is excellent, and the atmosphere is peaceful and relaxing. The restaurant is surrounded by beautiful greenery, creating a refreshing environment to enjoy your meal.

One of the highlights is the amazing wooden handicraft gallery above the restaurant, which is definitely worth exploring. The ground floor houses the restaurant, while the upper floors serve as a boutique hotel/BNB, giving the place a unique and charming character.

The food was delicious, and the drinks were equally good. Everything was fresh and well-prepared. I especially loved spending time here because of the calm ambiance away from the crowds.

It’s also a fantastic spot for photography and selfies, thanks to the beautiful architecture, greenery, and traditional artistic touches. Highly recommended for anyone visiting Bhaktapur and looking for great food in a peaceful setting. ||| A delightful gem in Bhaktapur, offering not just great food but a beautiful ambiance. The atmosphere is really nice, with a peaceful green space right in the middle of the square. It’s a calm and relaxing place to enjoy your meal.

The food is really good, and they have plenty of tasty vegetarian options. I had the tofu pad Thai, and it was amazing….full of flavor and just the right amount of spice.

Overall, it's a fantastic dining experience with excellent service, delicious food, and a tranquil setting. Highly recommend for anyone visiting Bhaktapur! ||| A great and authentic little Guesthouse and Restaurant. Absolutely beautiful setting with authentic but contemporary and well thought through decor. Is just a nice place to hang out and eat and drink. The local spirits they talk about on the menu is Rakshi and is pleasantly flavoured, I think with Cardamom, which makes it nice to sip.. unlike some of the rougher unflavored stuff that I tasted in Bhaktapur. Prices are quite reasonable compared to De Temple. ||| This restaurant is located inside an ancient traditional courtyard with beautiful decorations. It is calm and quiet in contrast to the busy city.
Here you can get excellent food, the staff is really friendly, and you get to relax a little. If you don't like spicy food, they will actually give you non-spicy food, not like in many other places where "not spicy" still results in a fire in your mouth for the average Western tongue.
It is one of the best places I've eaten in Nepal so far. ||| I find myself coming back to dine at Mayur Restaurant once every two three months. The food is soooo scrumptious, and the ambiance very serene.

This is the only place in Dattatraya Square that is actually a 5/5. Truly exquisite!

address: North side of Dattatraya Square, Bhaktapur 44800, Nepal
reviews:
This cafe and restaurant tends to be busy, and it's not that it isn't good but it's not remarkably better than other places in the square and is about 20% more expensive. I think it sees more business because it reserves tables for larger groups and so looks busy .. drawing more people in. At the time of our visit several items on the menu that this find elsewhere were not available Travellers Bistro across the street is less busy and in my view the food is just as good. Also for dinner, Mayur which is also across the street has good authentic Nepali and also international options in a nice setting, although the menu is much smaller. ||| We recently dined at De Temple Café, located right next to Dattatreya Temple. The view of Dattatreya Square from the café is truly beautiful and makes it a great spot to sit and enjoy the surroundings.
However, I was quite disappointed with the food and service. We didn't receive even the basic level of hospitality that one would expect from such a place. What made me feel even more uncomfortable was the noticeable difference in how local guests and foreign guests were treated. It felt unfair and unwelcoming.
I hope the management pays attention to this and improves both their service quality and guest experience, as the café itself has great potential because of its location and view. ||| One of the best Dal Bhat I had in Nepal
Tasty Vegetarian Jhol Momo
Original Banana Lassi

Yes. All above are common meals that easily found in Nepal. However having it in Bhaktapur Durbar Square with views from the second floor upgrades the experience of the Dal Bhat itself.

The Temple Cafe is very eye-catching from afar to me where it answers my curiousity to dine inside a historical site building.
Expect an outstanding bill for a Dal Bhat, Momo and Lassi with that outstanding experience and views 😂 ||| The food was very good. We can recommend the chicken momos, the pad Thai, and spicy sour soup. The view of the Temple and square is amazing. A star deduction for service. Authentic Newari Ambiance and delicious food. Loved it. And staffs are so friendly and we'll behaved. Highly recommend. ||| Had such a great experience here. Thanks ||| The butter chicken was so great. even the egg is very well cooked, super soft! ||| Amazing! Best Momos …

I got a buddha bowl with an extra egg.

Very friendly staff and comfy place ||| I had an amazing late breakfast at this place. First of all I got a very comfortable place to sit, at the window on a nice couch. Second of all is the food, just amazing. I got the smoothie bowl, a lassie, americano and the mung bean pancake with salmon and poached egg. I enjoyed every bite of it! I forgot to make a photo of the menu, but they have a bigger menu card than written on chalkboard outside. ||| Such a great cafe and people. Do yourself a favor and take a visit here. Tina and Poonam were very lovely as well as helpful. Pottery brothers were really kind and generous, guided us from start to finish while doing pottery. All of the staff were truly amazing.🤗

They also have rooftop restaurant upstairs with a great view in which you can enjoy your meal and relax.

Forgot to mention, there was variety of desserts and coffee items available in the cafe. It’s great to give a visit.☕️🍰 ||| Really cute place with great food at a very good price! |||  ||| Hami le newari khaja ​​set yomari liyako ma eakdam Mitho thiyo |||

Very friendly staff
Super affordable place ||| Waited 30+ minutes for a momo and the biryani never came. Atleast they could have said it will take time.

restaurant_name: Rato Ghar Hotel and Rooftop Restaurant
reviews:
I visited this restaurant while exploring Bhaktapur. A big thank you to the owner for being so kind, for the tea and for sharing great tips on how to explore the town. The food was delicious and all the recommendations were really useful. I’m also grateful for the help with taking my photo with this incredible view

Thanks ||| I stumbled across this beautiful restaurant on my first trip to Bhaktapur and loved it so much I came back and stayed in the hotel for 10 days!
The food is delicious, the view is amazing, and the service is wonderful. Try the Newari Set and the momos for sure. And the Bara is the best in town. ||| Comfortable place to try and enjoy some tea off of their extensive tea menu. The food is fresh and tasty. Beautiful view of the temple and a relaxing place to be. Highly recommend! ||| A very nice and authentic Newari restaurant. We had the traditional Newari celebration meal, bara with egg, and yomari — everything was delicious and reasonably priced. Ice-cold beer, a beautiful view over the temple, and friendly service made the experience very memorable. Highly recommended of you look for an authentic meal in Bhaktapur. ||| Can't comment on he quality of the rooms, but as a place with a great view and a great pot of tea it's fantastic. So many teas! Had the best hibiscus tea and masala chai - so good we brought some home as gifts. The owner works in a tea shop in portland, USA and really knows his stuff. Plus the view over the temples is beautiful!

Tried this place recently and honestly loved the experience. The food was super tasty, especially the momo, sekuwa and foods with special timmur taste. The prices were really reasonable. Drinks were available at MRP which was a nice surprise. The ambiance was clean and cozy, perfect for hanging out with friends or family. Service was also very warm and quick. You can tell they genuinely care about customers. Definitely one of those places you’ll want to visit again. I visit 2-3 times in a month. Addicted to Timmure and its taste. ||| Food here was amazing but guys the crazy part here is THEY LAUNCHED COFFEE. Today while visiting Polyclinic I saw Timmure being open around 8am. During day and evening this is my go to spot, but morning? Had no idea. Atti mitho coffee and beverages.
Will keep visiting. ||| The food was fresh, delicious, and beautifully presented. The flavors were excellent, and the portion size was satisfying. Great service and a wonderful dining experience overall. 🍽️✨ ||| Food Just Melted My Soul!
Second time here. Honestly, last time food was average but their specialty Timmure chicken is unique. On my way to home i entered for a quick bite and this time the food is MIND BLOWING!!
MUST VISIT….. the foods got better and i will visit here often with friends and family. 5 star doesn’t justify the taste 🤤🤤🤤🤤 ||| Had a great experience at Timmure Kalambinayak. The sekuwa was especially amazing, and every food item had an authentic taste. Absolutely loved the Timure Chicken full of flavor and perfectly cooked. The atmosphere was warm and welcoming, and the staff were very friendly. Another great thing was the alcohol served at MRP price, so we could enjoy without spending too much. Highly recommend this place for anyone wanting authentic Nepali food and a good time!

I am writing the review literally as I am still sitting here. It was my first time having Ramen, the staff was super helpful and everything tasted amazing!🤩 ||| This was my first time trying ramen, and it was absolutely incredible! The food was delicious, and the owner—who also serves as the chef—was exceptionally kind.
While the seating area is a bit cozy and parking is located a short walk away, the experience is well worth it. They even have a projector playing content to keep you entertained while you wait, which is a nice touch since great food takes a little time to prepare. With such affordable prices, I’ll definitely be returning soon. ||| Spicy ramen at reasonable price with your loved ones when at Bhaktapur. Highly recommended for family and couples time. ||| I have got a lot of reviews from my people so came here to experience for myself. The ramen was very tasty ramen. An average dining experience overall. The service was okay-nothing to complain about, but nothing that stood out either. It's a fine place if you're nearby ||| Super friendly staff, made us feel welcome and shared information about all the local foods! Highly recommended for great taste and smooth service! 👍 ||| I recently visited Food Bowl Cafe and Restaurant with a group of five people, and our experience was absolutely amazing! I highly recommend everyone to visit Food Bowl Cafe and Restaurant at least once. Highly recommended for anyone looking for a welcoming atmosphere and excellent service. ||| Wonderful staff, delicious food. Had the Veg Thali and Mustang Aloo, both very good

This is the best meal I’ve had in a LONG while. Everything from the flavors and local ingredients to beautiful presentations and the history behind each plate make this tasting menu a MUST TRY. They change the menu every couple of months to get the freshest ingredients during each season. The manager, Bibek, made the experience so enjoyable and memorable. Thank you! Will be back for sure every time I’m at Nepal. ||| Saw an ad of this place while I’m on the plane to Nepal and decided to give this place a try.
Price wise - totally worth it as it is a small fraction of the fine dining experiences I’ve had before.
Experience - Find it’s a bit cut short due to the explanation given by the server was not clear, sometime the voice projection were too soft, maybe this is something to improve on. Some dishes like the meatball also came to us in room temperature, not warm which baffled me a bit.

On that note, I always view fine dining experiences like this is like telling us patron a story behind every dish, but this time it felt like there isn’t any and I kept coming back to the menu to know more.

Ambiance - Deco was nice and traditional, and the restaurant is situated in the middle of housing areas but still quiet.
It was winter time and it does gets a bit chilly at night, which having the heater close was a relief, but once it moves around the warmth escapes you. Having said that it does affect the experience a bit.

Food taste: while I was quite excited to have my tastebuds tingled by strong spices and explosion of taste, I discovered that the dishes were made in almost earthy/natural taste-like. Maybe it’s Nepali cuisine -Tusa’s take but I doubt I’ll be braging more.
Overall the food is delectable, but doesn’t send me off smiling cheek to cheek.

However, I do applaud the effort to uplift local
Cuisine and wholeheartedly support what they are trying to do. I just had too much expectation! ||| I really would have liked to be delighted by this dinner in this restaurant in which I went especially to Bhaktapur from Thamel.
The overhaul experience was disappointing.
The restaurant is settled in a nice old historical building with a small courtyard.
The dishes are generally quite bland, even if an effort is made in their presentation.
We took the gourmet menu with the wine pairing for the sum of 12,000 nepalese rupees per person (approx 84 $ US).
It started with flavourless appetizer canapés. Then the consommé and its meatballs had very little flavour and was served warm. The river fish was also quite bland, far from what one could imagine, Nepal being full of varied spices.
The pork-based dish was better but nothing really impressive in terms of taste.
The wine was good.
In view of the price, the experience was therefore disappointing. ||| Delicious food, nice atmosphere, kind staff. Open kitchen design, was nice to see the cooking :) We booked by phone. Top shelf eating experience!

🤩😍🤩 ||| Good food, good atmosphere, good vibe, the best newari dish  I have ever had. 😋 ||| Very friendly! Very testy and cheap! Strong recommend! ||| Never did i wait so long for my food. What made it worse was that this lunch stop was entirely the tour guide’s decision, and she was not transparent about it in advance. The fact that the guide paid nothing for her own meal clearly indicates that this is a commission-driven restaurant targeting tour groups. ||| I don't usually write Google reviews, but this time I felt I had to.
I would not recommend this restaurant at all.
The prices are extremely high, and they even charge Rs. 65 for a bottle of water, which is more expensive than 5 star hotels . The cleanliness standards are also poor. Ambiance was very nice with nytapola temple view
Staff was very friendly
I Recommend  this restaurant ❤️ ||| We visited this cozy little rooftop restaurant tucked away behind the iconic Nyatapola Temple. The rooftop seating, overlooking the bustling streets of Bhaktapur, provided the perfect spot to relax and soak in the lively atmosphere.

For food, we ordered Buff Fried Rice, Buff Chatamari, Chicken Thakali (not pictured), and ended the meal with the traditional Newari dessert, Yomari.

The Buff Fried Rice had a pleasant smoky flavor from the wok, but considering the price, the quantity of buff pieces was a bit underwhelming. On the other hand, the Buff Chatamari was excellent. The soft yet slightly crispy base, topped with flavorful buff mince, paired beautifully with the chutney, making it a delightful experience. The Chicken Thakali was also quite satisfying.

The real star of the meal, however, was the Yomari. They serve two Yomaris per plate, each traditionally filled with either Chaku or Khuwa. We opted for one of each. The Chaku-filled Yomari was exceptional — rich, caramelized, and absolutely delicious. Unfortunately, the Khuwa version didn’t quite live up to my expectations. In hindsight, I wish I had ordered both with the Chaku filling!

Very nice place for lunch under sun after city walk. Local food is very good. Staff very nice. The restaurant is beautiful. ||| What a wonderful place! I enjoyed visiting there very much. We visited Toboche Restaurant in the evening, and I honestly couldn’t have picked a better spot to relax after a walk around Bhaktapur. The restaurant is located just beside भाञ्ज्या पुखु (Bhajya Pukhu) , and it’s really close to the parking area, which makes it super convenient. We parked the vehicle, went for a peaceful walk around Bhaktapur Durbar Square, enjoyed the old city charm, and then came back here to eat before heading home — perfect flow for a chill evening.

Here are the highlights of the place that stood out:
1. Located near the parking, so no stress about walking too far after a long day
2. The view of the pond, sunset sky, and nearby hills was beautiful and calming
3. The ambience inside is cozy, with a touch of art and spiritual vibes on the walls
4. The staff were kind and polite, really made us feel comfortable
5. Washroom was clean, fresh, and well-maintained — a big plus!
6. It's just a few minutes away from Bhaktapur Durbar Square, which is great for both locals and tourists.

Now for the food :
~I had their buff steam momos, and they were super juicy, soft, and tasty. The chutney in the middle had just the right amount of spice and flavor.
~Also tried the spicy wings, and they were perfectly crispy and well-marinated — definitely recommended if you enjoy a spicy kick.

I didn’t try any drinks this time, but I noticed they had a good variety on the menu — something I’ll definitely try on my next visit. The prices were also quite reasonable for everything we got.

Toboche is a peaceful gem tucked right near the heart of Bhaktapur.... perfect for a good meal, good vibes, and a relaxing evening.

P.S. Couldn’t resist going back again a few days later — this time tried the peach tea (refreshing!) and their pizza, which had a crispy thin base and hit just the right spot. Something about this place keeps calling you back. ||| Had the worse chiken wrap of my life till date. Good location bad food.

We ordered cold drinks that was HOT like we had to drink lukewarm coke. Don't recommend at all please improve. ||| I had visited Matina Cafe in the past and had a reasonably positive experience. However, my recent visit was extremely disappointing, particularly from the perspective of cleanliness, hygiene, and overall restaurant management.
The approach to the first-floor seating area was noticeably dirty. The staircase and dining area appeared poorly maintained, with dirty tables and cigarette butts left around. The environment did not feel suitable for families, especially those visiting with children.
One of the most concerning aspects was the condition of the entrance area, where the toilet and hand-washing facilities are located. There was a strong unpleasant odor from the toilet, and the shared hand-wash area used by both restaurant patrons and toilet users was visibly unclean. This raises serious concerns about basic hygiene standards.
The dining area itself was uncomfortable due to unrestricted smoking. When customers smoke indoors, the space quickly becomes unbearable for non-smokers and particularly unsuitable for children and families.
The kitchen, located on the ground floor, also appeared extremely cramped and unhygienic. The sink was dirty, and food preparation practices were concerning. During my visit, momo dough was being prepared on top of a rusted refrigerator, with dough and wrappers directly exposed on the refrigerator surface. Such practices do not reflect acceptable food-handling standards.
Another issue was the apparent lack of separation between cleaning and food service duties. Staff members were observed cleaning dishes and floors and then serving food without any visible hygiene protocol in between. Basic restaurant hygiene practices, including proper handwashing and role separation, seemed absent.
Overall, the cafe appears to require significant improvements in cleanliness, food safety, staff training, and general maintenance. The location is excellent and has great potential, but the current condition falls well below the standards expected of a restaurant serving both local and international visitors. ||| The location of this cafe right opposite of the Nyatapola Temple in Bhaktapur is unbelievable. As is often the case in Nepal, operatic dogs sometimes launch into arias at night, but the scrumptious Shiva breakfast will soon fortify you against any loss of sleep.

Since 2016 or 2017, the rooms are very well renovated with tiled own bathrooms, hot water and good pressure in the showers, bedlamps, good lightning in general, excellent wifi and practical nicely designed storages in the rooms.

The view and setting by Durbar Square is something you can not get tired of watching as well as the locals going to the closest temple (Shiva's) getting their tica and doing their hindu morning rituals early in the morning.

If you go to Nepal, you will probably pass the Kathmandu valley. My advice is not to stay in Kathmandu. It is nowadays terribly poluted from traffic, both regarding noise, pollution, and traffic jams. Stay at Shiva Guest House in Bhaktapur instead. You reach Kathmandu if you have/want to in half an hour but the air and atmosphere is like from another world.

Nice place to have a coffee and tea. Backyard is very peaceful and creative. ||| Delicious cakes, aesthetically beautiful place to eat. Humble owner ||| I visited this café for work and had a great experience. The working environment is very comfortable, peaceful, and perfect for getting work done. The coffee was excellent and one of the best I've had.

I highly recommend this café and will definitely be coming back again. ☕😊 ||| Aesthetically beautiful cafe in Gwarko/ Satdobato area. Good quality coffee |||
Best crispy chicken with honey👌 ||| Keema noodles so goodd wrap is also good |||  |||  |||

Highly recommend for both golf lovers and those looking for a nice place to eat!

I ordered hot and sour soup, but the dish served did not match expectations. The taste and consistency were off, and it did not feel like authentic hot and sour soup. Hoping for improvement in the future. ||| A beautiful coffee shop in Patan. Slight off location, but that makes it even better. Though small, this cafe has its following. The food here is okey but lacks consistency. One day the food might be great but next time you go, the food serving size might be more or less; the food taste isn't consistent either. Sometimes good, sometimes bad.

address: Arun Thapa Chowk, 3 Jhamsikhel Rd, Lalitpur 44600, Nepal
reviews:
Top Of The World Jhamsikhel  has a perfect and welcoming atmosphere. It’s an ideal spot for meetings, working on your laptop or simply enjoying some quiet time with a great cup of coffee.
The seating arrangement  is very comfortable and the place is clean and well-maintained. The food is tasty and the coffee stands out with its strong, smooth flavor and well-balanced roast. The atmosphere is warm, peaceful, and beautifully designed, making it perfect for both casual meetups and work sessions. The staff are friendly, attentive, and always provide excellent service.
The food and coffee are consistently delicious, with fresh ingredients and well-presented dishes. The cafe offers a comfortable seating area, a cozy ambiance, and a welcoming environment that makes every visit enjoyable.

Whether you're stopping by for a coffee, a meal, or fresh bakery items, this spot is a must-visit! ||| This has been my go-to place for meeting friends, meetings or getting some work done at their workstations. I love their unique range of premium coffees, always a great experience!!

Best place for brunch. Egg’s Benedict are my favorite. The pancake’s were okayish tho. ||| Cafe Soma’s breakfast truly never disappoints. Every visit reminds me why it remains one of my go-to spots for a comforting yet well-executed morning meal. Great food, reliable quality, and a breakfast menu that keeps you coming back! Cafe Soma continues to deliver every single time. ✨ ||| The Soma breakfast was really good. And the sandwitches as well. The price was also reasonable. The staff are super friendly as well. We will definitely visit again to try other items on the menu. ||| The breakfast experience was exceptional. I savored the salmon Benedict, which stood out. Although I didn't venture into other menu options, both the egg Benedict and salmon Benedict were outstanding. Upon returning for another visit, the breakfast maintained its high quality, which is commendable. The fresh juice and coffee also lived up to expectations.

As a regular patron of this restaurant, I've sampled many of their dishes. Whether after a doctor's visit or a puja, I often gravitate towards this spot for breakfast or brunch, and thus far, it hasn't disappointed. Every dish delights my taste buds. I particularly enjoy the kimchi hashbrown for its spicy kick. The burgers. Are awesome as well.

I want to write good things about Filli, but I cannot to be honest. The Zafran tea is really good, however is on the expensive side. WiFi is terrible though. Go for the tea. I wouldn’t recommend it for lunch though. ||| First of all, the overall design is good. The seats are comfy.

Second of all, the food is very simple and good and all the DRINKS… Are super good, never failed in any. Zafran tea is a must.

Lastly, the staffs are so kind and considerate. I even remember their faces now🥰

(Please try the milk zafran cake it is special) ||| Just ordered their tea here and loved it a-lot the flavors really rich and the sweetness is just the way I like it. It’s really affordable and specially perfect for cold weather . The dd here Dikshya Malla was really sweet and her presence was comforting. 100% recommend the tea here at Labim mall. ||| I recently visited Filli Cafe at Labim Mall, and the experience was genuinely outstanding. Her communication skills, attentiveness, and dedication to customer satisfaction truly deserve recognition. Employees like Dikshya are the reason customers want to return again and again, and she absolutely deserves growth she represents the cafe.

Thank You Filli, LaBiM!!
Thank you Sweet Sanju and Diskhya!!!
Thank you Anil.
By Dhungana BiPraSh

One of the best tasting food restaurants in kumaripati,
My suggestion would be the jhol momo. ||| So good to spend time ||| Nice place to hangout ||| Ekdam dami thau |||

Really an amazing place - I am not typical to be so happy with a restaurant, but this one deserves it.

The young staff were first of all timely, attentive, and kind. The food was quick, and really delicious and priced well. Lastly the aila left us feeling good as we departed.

Try everything! You'll regret nothing. ||| We had a wonderful time at DALUCHA Cafe with my family. We tried their Bara, Chatamari, Lassi, and the Choila Set—everything was fresh, delicious, and full of authentic local flavors. The atmosphere is warm and welcoming.

Highly recommended for anyone visiting Lalitpur—this place is a true hidden gem worth adding to your Google Maps list! ||| It was an exciting experience. Nice people, especially the hotel owner sujjan he helped me and my parents in difficult situations. Their food was yummy. Cozy place with good drinks ||| Good coffee and great ambience ||| Very beautiful and vibrant cafe with organic tasty coffee |||  |||

This is one of our favorite Newari food restaurant located in Lalitpur, Nepal. Food is great and authentic. Dropped a star because the place is consistent. ||| One of the best newari eateries in jhamsikhel. The view from the top of this restaurant is breathtaking. Food - 4/5

Latte tastes amazing and they provide sugar syrup separately. I highly recommend this cozy spot to anyone looking to enjoy a relaxing time in a warm and inviting atmosphere. ||| A must-visit for coffee enthusiasts! Would love to visit again 😊 ||| Their Blueberry Matcha is a standout – smooth, refreshing, and perfectly balanced with just the right hint of sweetness.

address: भिन्द्यो क्व - सौग: लँ, Lalitpur 44700, Nepal
reviews:
Yala Cafe du Temple, Mangalbazar is perfectly located right in the heart of Patan Durbar Square, making it an ideal spot to pause and soak in the heritage around you. The rooftop offers a lovely view that truly elevates the experience.

The food is good, with the Mustang Aloo being a definite must-try. The cafe has an old-style, rustic ambience, and while it’s simple, the beautiful view makes it completely worth it. Their masala tea is absolutely fabulous; comforting and full of flavor.

The staff are kind and welcoming, especially the guy at the counter, who is genuinely friendly and makes you feel at home.

If you’re around Patan and looking for a cozy place to enjoy some quality time with friends or family, Yala Cafe du Temple is definitely a go-to spot. ✨ ||| Potatoes and mushrooms are my favorite in the veggies platter.

Sitting by the window, eating and enjoying the sunshine and view outside feels very calming.

I'm taking one star off for "Service" cause the food was a bit slow to come out. ||| Visiting here after ages. The ambience was the same as previous. Homely and cozy but a bit conjusted. The prices a bit expensive but as for the food, one of the few places where veg items were truly satisfying. The veg momo platter had 4 varieties each full of flavours. As for the cheese pizza which was a 9 inch pizza, it too was extremely flavorful. The milk tea however was not as good as I hoped for. As for the service, it was quite slow and had a hard time getting a staff to take the order or listen. ||| A place with a good view, but not tasty food and very intrusive waiters. The waiters obsessively offer to order everything on the menu. It's doesn't create the best atmosphere.
The toilet was very dirty with a terrible stench.
Prices are too high for such a place.

I wish you to get better, because the view is nice. ||| Café Du Temple is a gem in the heart of Patan Durbar Square. The ambiance is absolutely stunning, with a cozy environment that beautifully complements the historic surroundings. The café offers a delightful menu featuring Newari cuisine alongside other options, making it a perfect spot to savor local flavors.

The food is consistently delicious, and the friendly staff ensures you feel welcome and well taken care of. Their service is prompt and professional, which adds to the overall experience.

Whether you’re planning a family outing or catching up with friends, Café Du Temple is the ideal spot. The combination of great food, a serene atmosphere, and top-notch service makes it a must-visit for anyone in the area. Highly recommended!

Thank you!

address: M8GF+F5V, Nyakhachowk - Tapahiti Galli, Lalitpur 44600, Nepal
reviews: Here's a nice little cafe to go to when it rains!  Very good coffee.  Thanks for the welcome ||| The café is peaceful.

Beautiful garden ambience with a very peaceful and cozy vibe. Perfect place to relax, enjoy good food, and spend quality time. The staff are polite and welcoming too. Definitely one of the nicest cafe experiences in Lalitpur! ||| House 5 Cafe is located in a great area and offers a peaceful setting with well-maintained greenery. However, the experience on the food and service side needs improvement. During my first visit, I unfortunately found a hair in my food, which was quite disappointing. On my second visit, I tried the avocado toast, which was below average compared to similar dishes offered by other cafes.

The staff did not appear very welcoming and seemed to be in a rush while serving, lacking basic hospitality gestures. While the greenery creates a pleasant environment, it also comes with drawbacks—mosquitoes and insects can be quite bothersome, and there is a noticeable risk of leaves or dust getting into the food.

Overall, while the ambiance and location are appealing, the food quality, service, and hygiene concerns need significant improvement. Based on my experience, I would not consider visiting again. ||| Great experience overall. Went late but the food was delicious. Great atmosphere. Great people. When we asked, they explained it was because making a latte and cappuccino required more oat milk — but since we ordered just one latte and one cappuccino, being charged for four oat milks felt unfair.
As a barista myself, it would make more sense to charge for two espressos plus the oat milk used, rather than adding multiple oat-milk charges. Other than that, the place was pleasant ||| Recently visited House 5 and really enjoyed the experience. The ambience is beautiful, with lots of greenery that makes the place feel cozy and relaxing. However, I felt the service could be improved. A warmer welcome, like a smile when entering, and small gestures such as offering water upon being seated would make a big difference. I also had to press the service bell twice to get attention.

Overall, it was a good experience and I’d love to visit again. With a bit more staff training and attention to service, this place could easily become exceptional.

The space is cool. Good place to hangout with friends or work. The coffee and food.. so so. If you’re fine with average coffee with a nice ambience, this place is great. ||| One of the best coffee spots in town. We tried the pour-over coffee, which was recommended by the staff, and it had a truly rich and authentic flavor. You can really taste the quality of the beans and the care put into brewing.
The cheesecake and blueberry cake were equally amazing, fresh, well-balanced, and not overly sweet. The ambiance is calm and perfect for relaxing or spending time with friends. If you’re around Jhamsikhel, this café is definitely a must-visit. ||| Overall the ambience was good. The coffee was also good. Sevice could improve a little. Customer aayesi menu bhanda paila glass of water le welcome garnu bhaye it would be wonderful 😊 ||| I was craving a brownie with ice cream late at night and was glad to find this place open. Aesthetic and cozy spot with a beautifully designed interior that’s perfect for relaxing or catching up with friends. The food is tasty and well-prepared, though a bit on the expensive side. And let's talk about their coffee - it's simply exceptional!  Deli Akuj has you covered with their expertly crafted brews.

If you're in Jawalakhel and craving a top-notch breakfast accompanied by great coffee, look no further than Deli Akuj. Highly recommended! ||| A cozy place to hangout and enjoy coffee and food.
The ambience is amazing and cozy. I love to spend time here and enjoy the coffee.
However the coffee is quite expensive for the market but not sure if its worth the hype.
The food is amazing and price is worth the taste.

Food 4/5
coffee 3/5 due to price
Ambience 4.5/5
Parking 5/5 ||| It is one of my favourite places in patan to go eat. The smell of the freshly baked breads and brewed  coffee hits you as you enter. The menu has a wide variety to choose from with generous portions. Everything they serve is fresh and made to order.

I absolutely loved this place. The ambiance is calm and welcoming, creating such a peaceful vibe. The coffee was really good, and the Juju Dhau cake I tried was amazing. A must-visit for great coffee and a serene atmosphere! ||| I only had the coffee and it was good but the service was a 3/10. The ambiance of the place however is really lovely
