Special here sports live .. which I most likely... Feel fresh 🤍 ||| I didn’t like their customer service though I went their for 2 time they have same problem
No any greeting
I have to call the waiter every time for our food
It takes 40 min to arrive our food
Taste is not good
So disappointed with their service
Staff itself don’t know how to burn fire for campfire

in my personal opinion, the food could have been improved. I tried the spicy chicken wings, which were pretty nice. I also had the chicken gimbap, which was okay considering the price, but I feel the taste could have been better. Lastly, I had the kimchi bibimbap, and to be honest, I didn’t taste any kimchi in it. The rice was a bit bland, so there’s definitely room for improvement. Overall, it’s a decent place considering the price and location, but I’d give it a 3 out of 5. ||| Ordered veg Gimbap, instead of using sticky rice they used other rice so it didn't taste like
Gimbap. The keema in Keema noodle was too much deep fried. Ordered MoMo but only liked the keema and not the outer shell.
Alu paratha had no alu.
Atleast the chips chilli was decent. ||| We visited on 4th June and tried the keema noodle both chicken and buff, jhol momo, and C momo. I really liked the soup momo ko soup(khairakhum jasto thyo).However, the keema in both the chicken and buff keema noodles was very hard to chew, almost like sukuti. We actually came after seeing the keema noodle on Instagram, but it was quite disappointing but other dishes were worth trying🍀😋 ||| The food was okay but we had ordered thupa and it only came little not even half plate we ordered at exact 3:45 and it came like after 2 hours…. ||| Probably the  best Korean and Multi Cuisine food at most affordable price in Boudha....

The food looks appealing but the taste is not to the expectation... We went for their batuko ramen which was visually impressive but the taste was worse... Deep fried chicken and overcooked eggs on top did not match the taste.... I would rather eat an instant ramen noodle ... The area around  is also not that clean.... We also ordered chicken lollypop which had very hard batter outside and bland taste not even salt in the meat part....
Though it has a good ambience you can have a chill time with your friend with some drinks... ||| This place is very nice. We tried the cheesy ramen batuko and their keema noodles. The ramen was really creamy and I love the crispy fried chicken on top. The ambience is also very nice and there were board games that we could play while waiting. I had a great time with my friend. ||| Had to wait for almost 1 and half hour for 2 special fuchhe burger combo and 2 bowl of ramen.
They didn't even provide the requested items like extra spoon and water
Service here was the worst, the only thing i liked is the burger in that combo which was no bigger than a piece of momo ||| It was a expectations VS reality. The main dish 2x Batuko Ramen was uncooked and tasteless. Momo was Bland. But Chicken Lollipop was so good. And Pizza and Burger was also very tasty. ||| Such a cozy space the place was smaller then I thought but the food was amazing and clicked a tons of photos!!
Gonna visit it again sometime later

Good food, nice friendly atmosphere and good pricing. ||| one of the places to eat Chinese cuisine around Boudhanath that can be visited. the food is quite good and the price is quite friendly. moreover, the service is friendly. but the dining area is not that wide. ||| A very pleasant and quiet place to eat. The service is excellent. They serve not only Chinese food, but also Indian and Nepalese. I visited several times in 2024 and again in 2026, and the quality of the food remains very good. ||| Wonderful restaurant with a pleasant atmosphere! Very tasty food and not expensive. The most wonderful thing here is the girls who work here, very polite, kind and always smile sweetly when I come! I recommend trying Veg Thali ||| Most authentic Chinese food I've had in Nepal, if you're staying or visiting Boudha I would definitely recommend stopping by.

A beautiful place, very calm and peaceful. The small, intimate terraces in the back garden are lovely.
The staff are exceptionally kind and helpful.
The food is fresh and delicious!
Their momos and wood-fired pizzas are amazing... I highly recommend this place! ||| Good food, average smoothies, it took quite some time for the orders to be served but food was good so no complaints I guess. ||| Very good food and courteous service from Karishma..had some of my best momos in Kathmandu right here ...highly recommended .. ||| Kind staff and delicious breakfast. The potatoes with veggies are especially delicious. ||| If you're at Bouddha, this is the place to be. Amazing staff, amazing food and amazing atmosphere. I'm sorry but I'm going to gatekeep this place it's just too good to be true. Highly recommend, you'll not be disappointed.

Would absolutely recommend! The Chicken Dido set and Veggie T-Momo set that we ate was delicious and plentiful. Calm atmosphere, great service and cleanliness too! ||| I recently visited a lovely restaurant that offers a truly peaceful atmosphere. The view of Boudha from the rooftop is absolutely stunning. We ordered both veg and chicken thakali Khana sets, which were delicious.

The staff were incredibly polite and attentive, and the place was neat and clean.

If you're looking for a great meal with an amazing view, this is the spot to check out! ||| Nice place a few steps from main boudha korwa. To get to the restaurant head to the back of the ground floor of the yellow themed Ama Bakery and then take the stairwell to the 4th / top floor of building.

Small but clean bathroom with sitting toilet and sink, with an additional hand washing sink outside of the bathroom.

Not amazing but pretty good view of the top of the stupa directly from the tables.

Everything is good. However the saag greens are consistently over salted. Seating is semi covered so bring a jacket esp in evenings. ||| A very big disappointment. Don't believe in all these fake reviews like I did. You can see the picture below(exactly how it was brought) where we ordered a mutton thakali set and that's what we get 3 tiny little chumps of meat for rs650. Plus the veggies were too oily and tasteless. I don't know why people give such high reviews to such place. Lost all hope with Google reviews ||| I went there after seeing a TikTok video from a famous food reviewer. I ordered a thali, but they said they didn't have it, so I ordered mutton biryani. The portion was very small and it tasted a bit sour. Biryani is not supposed to taste like that.i think it was bashiiiii 🤮🤮🤮

address: P9C6+X98 Before Maya Bakery, Boudha Dhara Tole, Kathmandu 44600, Nepal
reviews:
My favorite cafe in the city. I lived near the stupa for two months and tried many cafés, but Pata is the best, I had dinner there every evening. The food is prepared very well and quickly -momos, soups, sandwiches, tibetan tea, lassi or a simple breakfast. All the momos on the menu are delicious. The girls who work there are always kind and welcoming, and the service is polite. We even photographed the food on film, we have such warm memories of this place. So if you’re staying near Boudhanath and want to find a place for a daily meal - come here. ||| I had a very disappointing experience at this place. I waited almost one full hour for my food, which is completely unacceptable. There was no proper communication from the staff about the delay, and I had to keep asking multiple times just to get an update. It felt like customers’ time doesn’t matter here at all.
When the food finally arrived, it didn’t even feel worth the long wait. The quality was average at best, and definitely not something that justifies such poor service. By that point, the whole experience was already ruined.
Good service is just as important as good food, and unfortunately, this place failed badly on that front. Waiting this long without any proper explanation or apology shows a lack of professionalism and respect for customers.
I would not recommend this place to anyone who values their time. Definitely needs serious improvement in service and management. ||| Very good food ans chill atmosphere. The egg chowmein was good and the mint lemonade delicious. Very close to Buddha stupa as well. I would recommend this restaurant compared to the ones just on the rim of the Buddha stupa. ||| I ordered from Pathao, the first time food was good. I ordered Chicken Thenduk and Veg Pakoda. but when I ordered for the 2nd time , they sent us in a very small plastic container. The portion was around 30% less than the 1st one, also the flour was not properly cooked, and they took the same price I could smell the flour raw , and they didnt even send us a hot sauce to have thenduk with instead they just sent a small drop of ketchup.

Ani, when we called them they were like hamro box nai sano aako cha tei vayera ho, yo pali ko lai sorry. This restaurant is a complete scam.. Full paisa tirera portion chahi sano diney ||| They have various seating areas. The food is good. They have parking for 2 wheelers as well. The service is quick too.

This place is always crowded, which clearly shows it has a strong following. The food tasted okayish during my visit, decent enough for a quick meal but nothing particularly standout.

However, the hygiene could definitely be improved. The space did not feel very clean, and the restroom was quite dirty, which affected the overall experience. With better cleanliness and maintenance, the place may match the popularity it seems to have. ||| I recently visited this Tibetan restaurant in the evening while roaming around boudha areas. We went in randomly, but it turned out to be a very famous and viral spot. The place was extremely crowded. We waited about 10 minutes to get seated, another 10 minutes to place our order, and over 30 minutes for the food to arrive.
That said, the food absolutely made the wait worth it. The dry mixed laphing was outstanding. I’ve never had laphing like that before, full of flavor and perfectly balanced. The chicken keema noodles were also amazing, and the chicken momos were delicious and well prepared.
Overall, the food quality justified the wait. The pricing felt reasonable for the service and atmosphere we experienced. I’d definitely recommend this place if you want to try their laphing, keema noodles, or momos. Just be careful about the spicy 🌶️. ||| Service was quick. One of the best Keema Noodles I’ve had recently. The momo was decent but the achar had a smell for my taste. Still definitely a place worth trying. ||| A good eatery if u r into more anglo tibetan dishes like tibetan momo,dry noodles,soup noodles,laphings etc…Quite popular with the locals and is moslty crowded during peak hours..The menu’s are not that extensive interms of the food items,limited and they do-not serve tea or coffee either,only cold drinks like coke/fanta etc…If u love laphings/ hot n cold noodles/momo with xtra spiciness then u must try this place😉…its located behind the Boudha Stupa,opposite to Kothey’s which is also a popular eatery around Boudha area…google map will b best to find the way if u have trouble navigating…..i had orderd the Chicken momo,Buff Soup noodles(hot) and Keema Noodles,the service was great,quick and responsive but if it is crowed then one have to wait for 10/15 mins for the food to arrive…..as for the foods,taste were okay for the price…..☺️ ||| Very disappointing experience ever 🙄
I visited this place yesterday with my two friends after hearing a lot of hype about the noodles. We waited quite a while because the place was crowded. Even while ordering, the staff repeatedly told us to wait “for a moment,” including for simple things like drinks.
The food itself was okay, but honestly the noodles tasted bland and lacked flavor. We understand everyone has different tastes, so that was not the main issue.
What really disappointed us was the service. While clearing our table, one female staff member behaved very roughly. She spilled soup all over the table while picking up the plates, and it splashed onto my clothes and shoes. 🫩What disappointed me the most was that she simply walked away without saying sorry or even checking if we were okay. 🤧Another waiter later came and said, “Sorry, don’t be angry she is just like that.”🤷‍♀️
That response was very unprofessional. Customers deserve basic respect and polite behavior. A simple sincere apology would have made a big difference. The experience left us feeling uncomfortable and disappointed. Never gonna visit this type of place again again !!😩😪

address: Stupa - World Heritage Site, Kathmandu 44600, Nepal
reviews:
I recently had the pleasure of visiting Pho99 Buddha Café, beautifully located right in front of the iconic Boudhanath Stupa, a UNESCO World Heritage Site. The location itself creates a very special atmosphere, blending culture, spirituality, and a relaxed café experience.

The Vietnamese soup served here is truly exceptional- rich in flavor, perfectly balanced, and prepared with great attention to quality. It’s one of those dishes that instantly makes you feel comforted and satisfied.

What impressed me even more was the warm hospitality of the staff. Every guest is welcomed with a respectful “Namaste,” which reflects a beautiful appreciation of Nepal’s cultural values. Seeing this gesture embraced by an international café makes the experience even more meaningful and memorable.

The terrace lounge is undoubtedly one of the highlights of this place. With the magnificent view of the Stupa, the ambiance feels calm, positive, and almost spiritual. It’s the perfect spot to unwind, enjoy great food, and soak in the peaceful energy of the surroundings.

Overall, Pho99 Buddha Café offers a refined dining experience with excellent food, gracious hospitality, and a truly serene setting. Highly recommended for anyone visiting the Boudhanath area. ||| Found this restaurant after discovered the stupa located right in front. My table was at the 4th floor it’s worth to walk up here the view was so amazing and calm I could see all around. Plus I could see Mt. Everest by far recommended by the staff. The staffs are very nice and hospitable. Food came with quite big portion but reasonable price the taste I would give 4/5 if I have a chance I would come back ||| Best Vietnamese Cuisine available in the Kathmandu Valley.

The service is super fast, and the hospitality of all the staffs is amazing.

You should experience the roof
Top seats of Boudha branch for excellent view of the Stupa.

Highly Recommended 👍👍

Enjoyed all the foods ordered. ||| Nice view, friendly staff.  We tried veg noodle and chicken noodle but both were tasteless ||| There are many options around the Stupa, but I liked Pho 99 the most. With a picture perfect view of the Stupa, the awesome food and staff along with some nice numbers playing in the background, make the experience memorable.

Vietnamese Fried Fish (Cá Chiên) is not on the menu but they made it for me. And it was amongst the best I've had in a long time. I had Pho Ga (Chicken Pho), which was nice - the sauces were too good.

A nice place to try a variety of teas, coffees, and snacks. If you're in the Boudha area and looking for a casual spot to hang out with friends, I recommend this place. However, it's not suitable for business meetings or formal drinks. ||| What a cute hidden gem on the second floor near Buddha Stupa!! I found the Masala a tad sweet but I swear by the Aloo Cheese Paratha!!! Loved the spices in the potatoes - it’s slightly spicy but oh-so-good when eaten piping hot!!! It’s so crispy outside and the flavour is amazing! Get it! ||| A place with a really cool vibe. Open terrace and a really good playlist. We go in the evenings for some matka tea😌☕ ||| Great place to be with friends & group  or want to chill alone, positive vibes & beautiful environment, must visit if you're in Kathmandu Nepal! ||| Seriously,! The best tea which I ever had in my life ☕
@chacha_chiya

This new restaurant near Boudanath Stupa is a must visit! Good momos, delicious paneer butter masala, excellent service and great value. Highly recommended. ||| We often visit this restaurant with our family. The food is excellent and the location is perfect. I highly recommend it if you are looking for a family-friendly restaurant near Boudhanath Stupa in Kathmandu. ||| Mitahara is a great place to enjoy Nepali cuisine at an affordable price. It also has enough space to accommodate small family gatherings and events. I highly recommend this place. ||| If you are looking for a good restaurant near Kathmandu, Mitahara could be a good choice for you. I have been there many times and I love the food and the environment, so I highly recommend it. ||| Food was great. We have already visited twice. Recommended for family gathering. Chicken khana set was very delicious

restaurant_name: ROKPA Garden Restaurant - Best Restaurant in Boudha
reviews:
I ordered the palak paneer and had to write a review as I am sitting at the restaurant. Ive ordered this dish all over the world and look forward to it if I see it on the menu. Im used to a well seasoned rich spinach gravy. This was not that at all. This was spinach soup. Maybe its because I showed up at 9 PM when they close at 10. I was very politely asked to pay midmeal because they start shutting down at 9:30 pm. The waiter apologized for the quality of the palak paneer wholeheartedly but I guess because the kitchen was closing there was nothing he could do 🤷‍♂️. I just paid the bill which included the full price for the palak panner. Disappointing because I was hoping to make this a new post-kora night  spot. ||| This is a very special place. I didn’t know anything about it, just happened to come here for dinner because it’s open an hour later than most other places. The fish and chips was the best meal I’ve had in weeks! Cooked to perfection! The staff was very cool and chill, and they gave me a trash bag to wear home in the rain cuz I didn’t have a raincoat. It’s my understanding that the restaurant is all for charity - ROKPA, I learned has been active for years. Awesome! ||| Absolutely love this space, had the Nepali thali but their other food is good too! There’s terrace seating available as well, and a small store selling locally made clothes and accessories. Staff is very nice. ||| Beautiful and quiet garden. And close to the stupa. Perfect for a break in the afternoon to read to draw...everybody are respectful to keep the place quiet.
I ordered a herbal tea with ginger lemon honey. I was delicious !! And the banana bread so tasty !!
The veg nepali set was amazing !
I plan to go back and eat here again at the end of my trip.
So peaceful place. ||| cute restaurant run by beneficiaries of a local NGO.

had the eggs florentine for breakfast, they forgot the spinach but the eggs, biscuit, hollandaise and potatoes were nice.

also came with two slices of bread with ham and butter,

tried a masala milk tea which was nice and light with lots of spice. sugar is kept on the side.

garden is currently under construction but there are still a few tables outside and a spacious indoor seating area.

a bit hard to find but just ask one of the guards at the ROKPA gate and he will point you in the right direction!

restaurant_name: Mamma Mia Stop Cafe & Restaurant(Indian, Chinese, Nepali, Pizza and Burgers)
reviews: Today is my first day in Nepal and I thought to try some local food and entered Mamma Mia Stop. Oh boy... Mamma Mia is Mammalicious.. Wonderful tatse, nice ambience with soothing music, clean restaurant and very good service. I recommend this to everyone.. Mamma Mia Stop Team, thanks for making my first day in Nepal more memorable 💖 ||| Best friendly service. Broad variety of delicious vegetarian dishes - and of course non veg, but we tried the veg only. If you are on the spot, you should definitely give it a try. I recommend! ||| Super nice food (geera rice, butter chicken, garlic naan to name a few), fragrant milk tea! Owner was also very hospitable, highly recommend! Wide variety on the menu too ||| Everything about this place was fantastic! We had Momo and Paneer Tikka Masala. Both were excellent. You have to try their “sadheko” momo, some of the best we have had in Nepal! Great Nepali tea as well. ||| Just stopped by for a quick lunch, with the intention to share a dish. (On Google the naan next to the good reviews, convinced us). We took the predmap noodles which were nice and not too spicy but their veg mix with garlic naan was off the charts! Amazing , would recommend to everyone. Bonus, it's a nice family run business who are all very friendly.

The Biryani here is a standout—truly one of the best local finds. The spices are the star of the show; they’ve clearly mastered the recipe. While the chicken wings were fairly average, the main course didn't disappoint in flavor or quantity. I highly recommend it, though I think using skinless meat would elevate the texture and overall experience even further. A solid "must-try" for the Biryani community! ||| I have to admit: they are my friends and I support their business but I can’t fake a review. They know I am quite strict with them and it’s just to help them developing!

I have been taking people several times here and all of them were very satisfied and happy.

Byriani is definitely delicious and all the staff is very welcoming. Little details in the service can be improved and I am sure they will do.

A plus is given by their charity program “Food for the poor”.

Love and compassion in action at a reasonable price and always a smile! ||| I had a really pleasant experience at this restaurant. The atmosphere feels warm and inviting, making it a great place to relax and enjoy your time. The staff were friendly, attentive, and made sure everything was just right without being overwhelming.

The food was definitely the highlight. Each dish was well-prepared, flavorful, and nicely presented. You can tell they care about quality and consistency. Whether you’re stopping by for a quick bite or a proper meal, it delivers on both taste and experience.

Overall, it’s a place I’d happily visit again and recommend to anyone looking for good food and a comfortable setting.

If you want, tell me the type of restaurant (cafe, fine dining, local Nepali, rooftop, etc.), and I can make it more specific and powerful. ||| Best biryani and indo-Chinese cuisine in valley. Highly recommended 💗 ||| Have tasted biryani all over Nepal but found authentic Biryani taste here only🫡. Very reasonable price for the quantity and quality. They serve other delicious Indo-Chinese dish as well. Must visit place.

You won't easily find brilliant Japanese food like at this restaurant.
The refined skills of the chefs truly shine through.
I was very satisfied with the ramen, fried chicken, and other dishes.
Not only is the food delicious, but the staff's hospitality is also top-notch.
If you want to eat authentic Japanese food, you should come here. ||| Truly Japanese ambience and respectful service , really felt happy to see the Japanese owners themself serving customers with a happy face. Totally Japanese styled sitting areas. Clean and fresh vibes all around .Food tastes authentic ! If you are missing Japanese royal services then u can go there. My Kids happy place too 🫶🏻 ||| First-ever Japanese restaurant at this Bouddha area with a Japanese couple of Chef and Manager.

Moved from Bangalore, India, Harima Japanese restaurant is now established and started their operation as Kathmandu branch here at Bouddha serving real Japanese cuisine with excellent selection of Japanese Sake of us.

The couple is waiting for your visits and straight comments on food, drink and their service to develop their place fit to Bouddha-Japanese-Sake-and-Food lovers.

Must try. ||| A Japanese chef is the head chef here. It tasted exactly like what I had in Japan. I got to experience the authentic flavor. Wonderful! I’m so happy to be in Nepal. ||| The food is very tasty and authentic. Service was also very impressive to me. Quiet with nice view from your table. We didn’t photo of all food we ate but all are good. Thanks and we will come back again for sure.

This is a small eatery where you can find the regular food like chowmein, momo, and thenthuk. I've had buff momo the times I visited and served with their house achar, it was so good! They also serve bone soup with it. They serve good milk tea as well. ||| Arguably one of the best momo in the area!!! Loved by the locals.
P.S. Still one of the better momos in the area. ||| It is a small run restaurant so not much fancy. If you want to taste a typical Tibetan momo then you should visit this. ||| One of oldest momo pasal in boudha area i heard !!!  Momo is so good must try when u around boudha area ||| Amazing momo  and very reasonable price.. very healthy and tasty.

It's always a great experience when the food is delicious and the staff is welcoming. I understand that the place is a bit small, which can sometimes affect the overall comfort and space. However, despite the size, experience with the food and service is good. ||| The food at this place always hits the spot! The momo is quite juicy, definitely recommend the shyabhale and their aloo fry and puri are a perfect breakfast combo. However, the service can be extremely slow. ||| Great quality food. Good prices. Nice ambiance and place . Go to place in Stupa area. ||| Pretty Cozy place .. They have indoor and outdoor sitting. Food was Good!!! Service was a bit slow. Prices are very reasonable!!! Would recommend this for tibetan style noodles!!! Thenduk was also good!!! ||| Delicious treats for your tummy! Once wasn’t enough so i had to try more dishes the second time. I’m still tempted by their buff momo and sha phale, but everything I’ve tried so far has made my taste buds very happy!! Next time I order, will remember to take pictures 😁
P.S. You'll be even happier if you pre-order before arriving at the restaurant. They are busy ppl serving many !!

Came here not knowing what to expect and left pretty happy. The Spicy Chicken actually delivers on the name  proper heat, not just a label. Lemon Chicken was lighter but had enough going on to be interesting. Both came out hot and tasted like someone actually cooked them.

Staff were easy to deal with. Checked in when it made sense, didn't hover. Got what we needed without having to flag anyone down twice.

The space is calm not trying to be anything it's not. Clean, comfortable, quiet enough to have a conversation. Went with a friend but a few tables had people eating solo and it didn't look awkward at all.

I'll be back. Good food, no fuss. ||| I had a fantastic meal at Khorlo! The Pork Fried Ribs are a must-try perfectly crispy on the outside and juicy inside with just the right amount of spice. I also tried the Chicken in Red Sauce, which was rich, savory, and incredibly satisfying. The flavors are bold and authentic. Highly recommend this spot if you're looking for high-quality fusion and traditional Nepali dishes in Kathmandu! ||| Dropped into Khorlo Restaurant & Cafe on a whim after being near Boudhanath Stupa, and it turned out to be a really pleasant surprise. The food was fresh, flavorful, and nicely balanced without feeling too heavy. Service was quick and easygoing, which made everything feel comfortable. What stood out most was the atmosphere, quiet, clean, and genuinely relaxing. It’s a great place to take a break from the busy surroundings and just enjoy your meal at your own pace. Definitely a spot I’d come back to ||| The Lemon Chicken was tangy and tender, and the Sour & Spicy Soup was a total flavor bomb. Great vibes, free Wi-Fi, and very welcoming service. Easily one of my favorite spots in the city now. I'll definitely be back to try more of the menu! ||| Khorlo has such a chill vibe. I sat in the outdoor area and it felt worlds away from the Kathmandu traffic. The Lemon Chicken was refreshing and light, and the staff really makes you feel at home. Great place to spend a slow afternoon.

The food and service were good. However, the food and drinks came to our table weird. We ordered drinks and usually all the drinks come together but we had a huge time gap between drinks for our table and for the food as well. The timing for the food and drinks was not good and something I would recommend working on that, but other than that, it was a delightful experience. It is a cool spot for friends or family. They can accommodate a big group as well. We had 9 people in our group. They also have a karaoke in the back that you can reserve, which is cool. ||| Super amazing K-BBQ! And farm fresh veggies served here too :) ||| Kimchee really delivered on flavor! The samgyopsal was tender, perfectly grilled, and super satisfying—especially when wrapped in lettuce with the garlic and ssamjang. Every bite hit just right. 🔥🐷

Also tried their kimbap and it was fresh, tightly rolled, and packed with balanced flavors. Not too salty or oily—just clean, classic, and comforting. 🍙

Overall, great food, cozy vibes, and worth coming back for more Korean cravings! ||| A must 5 star. I was not having much expectation from this place but it surely surprises me. you can find authentic korean food here. I am attaching menu and various pictures for reference. A must try place in Nepal if you would like to try food culture from different counties. The sitting arrangements are also good. in build cooing ovens are available in each table for cooking of your meat. multiple options including chicken, pork, buff meat are there. service is also good and price are very reasonable, ||| Amazing place at bouddha
They have authentic Korean food
They should have more Korean interior ,sitting setup. But not really happy with the service , it was slow. Apart , food was authentic but quantity was little less. Price can go little friendly. Food was top notch. Parking was available and adequate. I hope they will improve their service. Enjoyed our time their a lot.

The restaurant is good with good food. The service might be better. The meat if on grilled too long air will affect the dining experience. The corn sizzling is good and recommend. The Korean fried chicken is so so for us.  Not cheap but it is good overall experience. ||| A good place for Korean food though i am not a good judge of korean food. I did enjoy the dishes..
Side dishes were all we can eat there were 5 and o enjoyed 2 of them..
Korean fried chicken - a bit different but pretty good a bit too sweet for my taste
Kimchi Jiggae - was bit spicy ok not so great..
Kimbap - was good for me because it did not have too much fishy taste which i prefer
Egg roll was also quite good..
Rice was good and Sticky i liked the taste..

The restaurant is spacious and the staff are polite and prompt service..
Overall ambience is amazing.. A very fun place for korean lovers..

P.S. - there is 10 % service charge ||| One of the best Korean foods in K-Town. Would definitely recommend going here. The food is totally yum, The Samgyeopsal and the seaweed soup is a must have. Plus, the staffs are really friendly. They also have a collection of hanbok to try. They also have a lot of Korean items on display adding to the ambiance. The parking is also ample. Additionally, they have a lot of tables but the only thing that is a downside for me is they only have one floor table which is unavailable most of the time which kills off the vibe.
Overall, a great place to have Korean. ||| Best Korean restaurant located inside Hotel Ngurdrup -Boudha. We ordered Gimbap (Kimbap) , Bibimbap, Kimchi Jjigae, Ramyeon with rice cake and the star of the Korean cuisine, the infamous Samgyeopsal. The ordered food was very tasty and fresh as well as the quantity was larger than any other place in Kathmandu. The bowl full of Bibimbap was extremely flavorful. What can I say about the pork barbecue that hasn't been said before. We opted to cook them ourselves as we wanted to experience that as well but we were guided by the staffs.
The portion that you get here is very much fair for the price which itself is lower than all the Korean restaurant in the valley. The staffs are very respectful and responsible  in terms of orders. Highly recommended guyss!! 👌 ||| A delightful experience for anyone craving authentic Korean cuisine. The ambiance of the restaurant is comfortable, though not particularly impressive. Good espresso drinks. I wish there were one or two actual dining tables—a little higher with straight back chairs..in addition to the lower ‘bar style coffee tables’  I am older. Food is tasty and they keep English daily local papers handy, a great morning coffee break spot! ||| A quiet corner around the bouddhanath area for those who want view of the stupa, without the usual crowd

So nice and helpful young people, randomly discover, I had some headache . The owner helped me to get into pharmacy and get some medicine. I had buffalo curry and rice then some chai masala delicious 👍. ||| Probably the best breakfasts I've had in Boudha.
The portion size was great, everything was cooked really well. It took a bit of time to come but I appreciate when a cafe takes its time to do a decent job.
Coffee was good (for the standards of the area).
The atmosphere is chill and I could sit and draw while I waited.
The playlist was also easy to listen to, soft morning jazzy and at a good underscore volume, no chart, pop rubbish, thank you. So many places around here are ruined by their selected soundscape.
Much appreciated, I'll be back 🙏 ||| Yesterday, We visited for breakfast around at 7:56 am and ordered the food. The FOH lady, waitress informed us we gonna open at 8:00 am sharp and the food will take max 15-20 min to bring out the food.

However the food arrived after 45+ minutes, to be exact 8:49 am

We order 2 lemon tea, Chicken Thukpa and Avacado Power breakfast

Thukpa was average but the Avacado Breakfast was very disappointing, every item was super cold on it, toast was too soggy

Need to pay Total bill of 1050 around which would have been fine if the service and food quality matched expectations

Unfortunately,
No apologies No proper communication or updates for being delay and Cold food was served without acknowledgment ||| Lovely nook to hangout with friends. Great idea of having carrom, chess and doodles to keep visitors engaged. Welcoming and humble hospitality 💫 ||| Fantastic food and vibes - delicious masala tea. 10/10 would recommend to a friend!!

I had been wanting to visit this place for a long time, and I finally got the chance. The food was delicious, freshly served, and full of flavor. The staff provided warm and friendly service throughout our visit. The place is spacious, surrounded by nature, and offers a peaceful and quiet atmosphere; perfect for relaxing and enjoying a meal. Highly recommended! ||| At my first visit I really enjoyed the food. I had the Chilli Momo, which was delicious and very spicy. The service was wonderful, and the evening atmosphere was lovely, especially with the beautiful inner courtyard and the lighting. The wait time was a bit longer than I would have liked, but the place was quite busy, so the kitchen was likely struggling to keep up with the orders. Overall, I had a great impression. Clean spot and reasonable prices.

Upd. Visited during the day for lunch and it was so crazily overcrowded. Some menu positions were not available and it was hard to get waiters attention. The food was mediocre, quite blank in taste. The breakfast experience with a smoothie bowl was just bad. ||| Relaxing atmosphere, good food and friendly service. Has to be the best vegan/vegetarian cafe on this town. No complains at all. ||| We visited Utpala Cafe for lunch as an office team, and unfortunately, our experience was very disappointing. The lentils (dal) had a bad smell and did not seem fresh, which made the meal unpleasant. When we brought this to the staff’s attention, the response was not helpful or professional. Instead of addressing our concern properly, we felt that our feedback was not taken seriously.

We expected better food quality and customer service, especially when dining as a group. We hope the management improves both food hygiene and the way customer complaints are handled so that other guests have a better experience. ||| I absolutely love this restaurant in Kathmandu and have been coming back since my very first trip. The food is simply delicious, with plenty of amazing vegan options to choose from. They also offer fresh juices and homemade drinks that are absolutely worth trying. What makes this place even more special is the fantastic service – the staff are incredibly friendly, attentive, and welcoming, making you feel at home right away. The beautiful garden creates such a relaxing atmosphere and adds to the overall experience. I highly recommend this wonderful place and will definitely keep coming back!

A hidden gem. Cafe Caravan has one of the best views of the stupa, making it an ideal place to sit, relax, and take in the atmosphere. The food is tasty the menu options are hard to find elsewhere like bagels and cream cheese, etc.

The carrot cake is hands down the best you’ll find in the country, and the coffee is excellent. The staff are extremely helpful and attentive, which really adds to the overall experience.

The vibe is distinctly Tibetan, giving the space a warm and authentic feel. They also have a great gift shop featuring handicrafts and beautiful art, including pieces from well-known artists from Dolpa.

Highly recommend stopping by if you’re in the area. ||| Breakfast bagel was bad, didnt taste like cream cheese. Pasta was decent and the peach iced tea was good. Brownie was okish.
The place is quiet and the views were quite nice.
Its a good place for drinks and views i guess, but i wouldnt recommend the food. ||| Since they open it has been a place of peace, joy and good spirit.
If you come once, you will always come back.
Now they have this amazing rooftop, one of the best view in Bodha. ||| This is my favorite café. The carrot cake is literally my favorite thing here absolutely delicious! The ambience is very pleasant, making it a perfect place to relax. The staff are super nice and friendly, which makes the experience even better. I truly love this place. ||| The view is great, coffee is good. They also sell good quality Nepalese handcraft. Ideal for a slow morning coffee. Sit by the window and watch people circling around the Stupa. Very nice staff and good music too. Cash only though. The washroom should improve and have soap as a minimum.

Visited Filli Cafe recently. The atmosphere was pleasant and the drink was decent, but the service was a bit slow during my visit. The prices felt quite expensive. One concern was that the seating area near the windows had an unpleasant smell, apparently due to pigeon droppings outside, which affected the overall dining experience. Overall, it's a decent café, but there is room for improvement in cleanliness, service, and value for money ||| Visited Filli Cafe and tried their burger 🍔. The burger was really tasty and fresh, with good quality ingredients. The overall vibe of the cafe was nice and comfortable, making it a good place to hang out. Service was also decent. Definitely worth a visit for a quick bite ||| Had a wonderful time at Filli Cafe in Bouddha. The food was absolutely delicious, beautifully prepared, and full of flavor. The ambience made the experience even more special—peaceful, cozy, and perfectly complemented by the stunning view of the Boudhanath Stupa. Enjoying great food while looking at the stupa felt truly magical.
The service was excellent—friendly, attentive, and welcoming throughout. What made it even better was sharing this lovely experience with friends, laughing, talking, and enjoying the moment together. A perfect place for good food, good vibes, and great company. Highly recommended! ||| Café Filli in Boudha is a cozy spot with an amazing view of Boudhanath Stupa. We tried their coconut hot chocolate and mint hot chocolate ,both were rich, creamy, and full of flavor. Perfect for chilling, catching up with friends, or just enjoying a peaceful moment with a beautiful view 🤩👀 ||| Excellent food and Atmosphere. Excellent customer service provided by the staff Akansha. Cocktail samosas, Zaffran milk tea and milk cake is a must try..

The matcha was a bit disappointing it tasted quite watery and the flavor felt light for the price. It would be great if a bit more attention was given to the matcha preparation and quality.

The atmosphere was lovely and the place has a really nice vibe. The bakery items and the other drinks were really good. ||| A beautiful coffee in the heart of Boudha. In just a few minutes walk you can reach Cafe Chitra from Boudha Stupa. With its "green garden" and great selection of drinks, it's like a little oasis in the middle of the urban hustle and bustle. ||| Amazing coffee and the ambience is gem for a Boudha hangout!Specialy it has lavish parking. ||| Very nice and lovely place for a coffee.
Dami cha sathi haru. Do visit. ||| I came across this gem while walking through a neighborhood on my way to the Buddha Stupa. The service was amazing and the cappuccino was great. On my way out I needed to go to the bathroom so bad that I left forgetting to pay. I want to apologize for my mistake, especially when the service and drink so so great. Unfortunately I’m 45min away from this place. Sorry about that.

Stopped by this café and had such a lovely experience! The coffee was rich, smooth, and perfectly brewed – you can really taste the quality. They also have a great selection of refreshing drinks, perfect for a hot day. My friend tried one of their iced specials, and it was super fresh and energizing.

The atmosphere was cozy and welcoming, with a relaxing vibe that’s perfect for catching up with friends or just enjoying a quiet moment. The staff were friendly and quick with service too ||| “Bodhiz Café is a hidden gem in Boudha! The atmosphere is peaceful, perfect for relaxing with a cup of coffee or enjoying a delicious meal. The food is fresh, flavorful, and well-presented, with great vegetarian and vegan options. The staff is friendly and attentive, making the experience even better. Highly recommend this place for anyone looking for good food and a calm ambiance in Boudha!” ||| A small cafe which serves hot and cold non-alcoholic drinks with healthy food options.

We ordered coffee/ tea/ Matcha bubble tea/ Lassi and avocado mushroom sandwich - delicious . Recommend this place for drinks and healthy breakfast western options. ||| The staff was friendly and attentive. In addition to the great drinks and food, the cafe had a comfortable seating area, perfect for enjoying a quiet moment or catching up with friends. Love the matcha tea its my go to place for morning tea and I absolutely love the cookie over there. ||| Place was so comfortable, staff was great and I like there Spanish latte and fruits salad  ,delicious ever 🥰

address: Stupa, Boudha Stupa, Arabica Coffee, Kathmandu 44600, Nepal
reviews:
Paljom was our barista, she was very welcoming, and provided great service, her English is fantastic!

The COFFEE is the best we have had in Nepal so far, absolutely excellent.

The fresh lemonade soda is to die for!!

If you looking for a nice quiet place to recharge at the Stupa, this is your place.

Prices are good and affordable too! ||| Best coffee I've had in Nepal in 15 years.
My group and I stopped and left very happy.
Coffee was excellent,  fresh lemonade was brilliant and cookies were YUM.
Prices are cheaper than most other coffee shops too.
Paljom  smiled and gave great service.
I will bring my groups here from now on.
THANK YOU 🙏 ||| A nice little cafe with a great view of the Stupa. Friendly staff and they have great cheesecake. ||| Great ambiance, good coffee and friendly staff. And the window view was amazing 🤩 I just loved it!!❤️ ||| In frame - Frappuccino and carrot cake

Excellent, happy welcoming, inviting and friendly service. It was my 1st time in this cafe/restaurant as l like to try as many as I possibly can. I really enjoyed the experience earlier in the morning as the Stupa was vibrant and full of energy. After an hour of blissfully strolling around l came in for a coffee and then I came back for lunch as the menu inspired me to try 2 of their salads. Well on my return the welcoming was once again warm and inviting.

With excellent views of the stupa like most of the restaurants in this area, it was time to order the Avocado and quinoa salad & grilled chicken Caesar salad.
Wow wow - both salads were so well made and presented. Great flavours.

Highly recommend 🤘🏼👍🏻🙏🏻❤️ ||| Its a nice and cozy coffee shop with some extra bites offerings. I tried their espresso..It was ok but not as per my standard...Dark Roast and under calibrated..May be good for milk based but as I like my coffee to be milkless of any kind..I don't refer the espresso..Didnt get much time to check the their drips as the ankle biter was giving me hard time and their veggie burger was just okay..need to work a bit more onto many things. But the staff were very friendly yet peofessional and welcoming. ||| My wife and I returned to Peedee in early February after visiting 12 months ago. Waiter/barista Rohan remembered us and gave us a warm welcome. He even remembered our coffee preference. The coffee - a small cortado - was excellent and less expensive than some of the busier cafes at Boudha. There are excellent views of the Stupa from comfortable couches in different levels and from up on the rooftop. It’s a great place for a relaxed first coffee of the day. Thank you Rohan. ||| Beautiful view of the Boudha Stupa from inside. It was quiet and peaceful, which made for a really relaxing experience. We had the delicious spaghetti and keema noodles, both very tasty. I ordered the wrong coffee (meant to get an iced latte), so I didn’t enjoy it as much, but that was on me. The service was attentive and friendly. Overall, great food, great views, and a calm atmosphere! ||| I recently had breakfast here, and unfortunately, it was the worst experience I've ever had. This used to be my go-to place for breakfast as I stay in Bouddha , and the meals were always enjoyable. However, today was a big disappointment. The hash browns and sausage were cooked in what seemed to be old, unfresh oil, and the bacon was far from the quality I’ve come to expect here.

When I requested an exchange, they simply reheated the same food and brought it back, which was really disappointing. Given the price, I expected much better quality and service. Sadly, after today, I don’t think I’ll be returning.

Overall an average experience.
The veg thali was good and quite satisfying, with nice flavors and variety. The egg thukpa was also enjoyable and comforting. Jhol momos were definitely a highlight — flavorful and well prepared.
However, the mutton thali was disappointing as the meat was quite hard and not tender at all. The burger and fries also seemed stale, which took away from the overall experience.
A mix of good and not-so-good dishes — some items really stood out, but consistency needs improvement. ||| My family,we visited this place for dinner & we get the worst experience in this flavour Cafe inside bauddha stupa food was unhealthily and service was worst they did even care about the reviews we make , and i found that the are also false marketing by showing different pic of the restaurant.  They are showing pic of taragaun falvour cafe and falvour cafe inside bauddha stupa . Bauddha stupa falvour cafe i recommend with Zero star don't visit this cafe yoh will only find good looking but zero sense of restaurant businesses ||| The chef needs to be fired . Came here for breakfast , The food quality is very disappointing . Sausage was not edible . ||| I just walked out with my family from this restaurant for their poor service. This was a disappointment because when I had come here in 2022, the food had been good. But today was a different experience altogether.
We ordered french fries, veg gimbab, tea momo, mixed veg curry, chicken kimbab .
The french fries was soggy and plain yellow with tiny black spots. We did not fuss accepting that oil residue. But the fries came alone with nothing. When we asked for a sauce they brought us a spicy hot sauce that is the base sauce for keema noodles. When we asked for the ketchup, they said they give that only when we ask for it. It is strange that they expected us to have french fries with no sauce or ketchup to dip in.
Second, the mixed veg curry with rice came. The server had suggested mixed veg curry for us to eat with tea momo. When the mixed veg curry came it came with rice surprising us amd no tea momo. the mixed veg curry was watery broth of paneer and mixed vegetables. Upon enquiry, it came around ten minutes later which was not fluffy and smelt pungent. The taste was slightly sour. We called them amd asked them about it. One of them came and tried explaining to us how it is made. We made him taste it. And he said he will cancel the order of tea momo but rest of our orders will not be cancelled saying our cancellation came too late. We paid NPR2155/- for all of our orders and left the two food that could not be cancelled. We did not have the courage to taste it.
The first server who was actively serving had been annoyed and walked away from is when i had pointed out to her how our order for tea momo was in line with what was mentioned in their menu. ||| Serene garden like environment in the middle of the busy Stupa center! A little hard to find but worth the effort.  Incredible diversity of menu, food was tasty and budget friendly. Service was great.

address: Pawo Gompa Marg Near, Utpala Cafe, Kathmandu 44600, Nepal
reviews:
Karma Coffee at Utpala Boudha is one of those rare places where everything feels balanced the ambiance, the food, the service, and the peaceful environment around the monastery.
The coffee here is genuinely exceptional. Whether it’s a classic cappuccino, a smooth latte, or their perfectly brewed pour-over, every cup tastes fresh, rich, and crafted with care.

The staff deserves special appreciation. They are friendly, polite, and attentive without being intrusive. They take time to guide you through the menu, check on you just at the right moments, and maintain the overall peaceful vibe of the place. Service is smooth and timely, even when the cafe is full. ||| Breakfast was a bit disappointing, it felt dry and didn’t really justify the price. The portion size also seemed small for what we were paying. That said, the coffee was excellent as always and definitely the highlight. ||| Really loved this café in Boudha! The drip coffee here tastes amazing — smooth, rich, and freshly brewed. You can tell they really know their coffee. The cake (juju dhau )cake was kinda dry though..The place has such a calm and cozy vibe, perfect for relaxing or catching up with friends. The ambience around Boudha just adds to the charm. Definitely one of the best spots if you enjoy authentic coffee and a peaceful atmosphere. ||| If you're a coffee lover wandering the streets of Kathmandu, Karma Coffee near Boudhanath is worth a visit. This charming café serves high-quality organic coffee in a warm, peaceful setting. Whether you're in the mood for a quick espresso or want to linger over a pour-over brew, the ambiance here encourages you to slow down and savor the moment.
The staff are friendly, the space is tastefully decorated with a touch of local flair, and the calm environment is perfect for reading, working, or just escaping the city buzz for a while.
A must-visit for those who appreciate artisanal coffee and cozy corners. ||| Don't make the same mistake I did. Do not order the coffee smoothie. It's horrendous. The consistency is very strange — thin and runny like milk, rather than thick like a proper smoothie. And the taste was just monstrous; it wasn't just bitter, it tasted burnt. It was completely unbalanced and not tasty at all. I couldn't even finish this 'masterpiece'. Americano coffee I tried another time was ok. The cafe vibe is fine in general but staff behavior is not friendly.

Best live music I’ve heard in years of travelling, I thought it was a bold move covering Hendrix, but they smashed it. Good draught pint and plenty of locals there, which is always a good sign. I wasn’t hungry but the food looked good and everyone looked happy. I’ll be back. Loved it ||| Went to this cafe for a meeting a client. The place looks very natural and sets a perfect example how neat cleanliness can make a desirable cafe. Place was filled with random decorations. And also has a live music. Total recommend this place to visit. ||| If you came here looking for high-class cuisine, you misunderstood the concept. If you came for authenticity, visual overload, good music, a cold beer or two, and the vibrant energy of the local youth, then this is the place. A raw, honest and lively spot that I’m happy to recommend. ||| Went with low expectation.
Vibe check was OK... But then downhill from there....
Considering the place I got the menu myself, went to the counter and place order myself. They forgot our order 3 times and took 1.5 hours to serve up 3 snack dishes. Waitresses was friendly enough and told us since it's Friday so very busy. 😳🙄. To top it off the original seats we sat down was advised as "reserved". Through out the evening we didn't see anyone sat there. Do go visit this place with a "white foreigner", they will provide good service ||| They seem to go out of their way to impress foreign customers while completely ignoring Nepali customers. The difference in treatment was obvious and very disappointing. Every customer deserves the same level of respect, regardless of their nationality.

On top of that Kale Sau had a very rude and unprofessional attitude, which made the experience even worse. Poor customer service and clear favoritism. I won’t be returning, and I wouldn’t recommend this place unless they start treating all customers equally.

address: Boudhnath, KL tower, 3rd floor, काठमाडौँ 44600, Nepal
reviews: Visited few days back for a quick afternoon snack. Ordered veg momo which was okeyish. Its wasnt that good. Veg cutlet were fried perfectly. Sweet lassi was good garnished with dried fruit and khuwa. Overall atmosphere was kind of loud. Fast service ||| The food they provide taste great. The barista training felt easy and understandable. I recommended this place for good food and easy and great barista training. ||| Thank you, Teen Tongue Cafe! I had a wonderful experience here and learned so many valuable things. I truly appreciate the entire team for guiding me with such ease and making me feel comfortable. The environment is very friendly, supportive, and always ready to help. Highly recommended!👌👍 ||| The barista was so friendly and efficient, making my coffee experience enjoyable. I really appreciate their positive attitude and helpfulness. The coffee was also fantastic, and I would definitely recommend this place based on the outstanding service! ||| I had so much fun while having training 🫶🏻 all the members are so friendly and I felt like a home ❣️ 21 days felt so short . I learned many new things. I will 100% recommend this place for training ❤️ Deep thank to Teen tongue cafe ❣️I will miss this place . Lots of love 💕🫶🏻🫶🏻

This is a quite rooftop cafe with modern vibe having a unique range of items available in their menu... Definitely a go to place if you like coffee and quite ambience.... The entrance is a bit scary as it is a steep steps... So be careful while you logout.... ||| If yours looking for a peaceful and cozy and also affordable cafe in Boudha, recommend visiting here. Located about 11 mins walk in the road opposite of Boudha gate, this cafe offers a peaceful and cozy ambience. The menu limited yet varied and the prices quite reasonable. As for the drinks full score and the waffles and smoothie bowls here are highly recommended. ||| Really nice place with a clean and modern design. The food was tasty and fresh, and the drinks was great too. Staff were friendly and helpful. A good spot to relax or have a quiet meal. Would definitely come back! ||| I recently visited Logout Cafe and had a great experience. The ambiance is cozy and modern—perfect for catching up with friends or getting some work done. Their coffee was rich and aromatic, and I especially enjoyed the seasonal healthy bowls they have. The staff was friendly and attentive, making the experience even better. Definitely worth a visit if you’re in the area and looking for a relaxing spot. ||| Was here to meet friends and have lunch.
Loved the ambience and food.
Had smoothie bowl and Sandwich with coffee. Food was best.

The clay buff hotpot was disappointing. I expected a richer and more flavorful dish, but it tasted bland and lacked seasoning. Unfortunately, it did not live up to my expectations.Other kiwi refresher and cold coffee were good. ||| The way I been in the cafe is the way on point to be with loved ones in same place to unite with friends and family and the win the hearts of loved ones of mine and our Nepali people in the way that we provide service and the time we are available for beings to serve with the style and life of win hearts in the times of generation of life of Nepal and Nepali. ||| Today 25 May 2025, I visited Malay Café in Ramhiti, one of the more talked-about spots in my hometown, known for its unique hay themed, rural style ambiance. At first glance, the place looked vibrant and busy, with all tables occupied as we entered. The rustic decor was quite appealing and offered a refreshing setting.

However, the service left much to be desired. Upon arrival, no staff acknowledged us, several waiters walked past without a greeting or offering any assistance. We had to find our own seating, eventually settling at a small two-person table.

Even after sitting down, we were ignored for several minutes until we had to call over a waiter ourselves. When he approached, I asked if he was available to take our order, he briefly replied, “I’ll get the menu,” and returned with a damp unkempt menu without any form of greeting or welcome.

I ordered two Americanos as they didn’t have filter coffee. There was no attempt to suggest food pairings or bakery items that might complement our drinks. Since I was hungry, I called another waiter and requested Tea Mo:Mo. I also asked for a recommended dish to go with it, to which he suggested “Sabat,” mentioning it was made with buffalo meat. I agreed and asked how long it would take, he replied 5 minutes and rushed off.

The coffee arrived shortly after. Unfortunately, it had a burnt aroma, with a sesame like nutty flavor and a light acidity. The aftertaste was harsh and lingered unpleasantly. Disappointed, I inquired about the coffee beans and was told it was Himalayan Arabica. I asked to see the product, and while the barista agreed, he never returned with it, stating they were “busy” at the time.

Our food took about 15 minutes to arrive—three times the estimated wait. The Tea Mo:Mo was decent, but the shabta was disappointing: the meat was dry, not tender, and lacked flavor. It didn’t complement the gravy, and the tomato base tasted off, almost spoiled.

Overall, the service was inattentive and unprofessional, with staff appearing more focused on socializing than attending to customers. The café also lacked basic cleanliness, both the toilet and wash basin were dirty.

During our 30 minute stay, most tables were filled with guests smoking hookah or drinking beer, creating more of a bar atmosphere than a cafe. It didn’t feel like a suitable place for enjoying quality coffee.

We settled the bill and left with an awkward and unsatisfactory experience. While the ambiance was charming, Malay Cafe fell short in terms of service, product quality, and overall hospitality. ||| This cafe is beautifully decorated. This place has many plants and the outdoor seating gets good sunlight. The food is good, service is quick and they have parking too. If you are non smoker, you might be bothered with the smoke as most of the customers there do smoke and have hukka. We had to change seats in 2 visits due to that.  They have wide variety of seating areas. So, you can change the seats like we did. I took my dog too. They are pet friendly as well. This place is worth the visit. ||| This is place is so nice, the ambience is great and the vibe here is immaculate. All the food and drinks I have tried here were amazing and the prices are also very reasonable. This place looks so beautiful during late afternoon. Loved the matcha latte here.

restaurant_name: Organic smoothie Bowl and Cafe - Boudha
reviews:
I often visit here for healthy Avocado Smoothie bowl "The hulk" and as usual today we three friends went here and ate The hulk Smoothie bowl.. American bread toast, pancake and masala tea. all foods are 10/10. Well, please enjoy you too. Well, my request is please surve the water on table first..and play some classic music and put some sofa seats. Thank you. ||| This is a superb place to get something different to the normal fare on offer.

Large portions make this place extremely good value for money.

The food is delicious and generous.

Young, friendly staff.

Highly recommended. ||| Small but cozy place with delicious food. Fancy menu compare to most of the places. You can get all sorts of avocado toasts and smoothie bowls.

I had kitchadi, which was great. If you like to start your morning with porridge, this could be a great option.

Smoothie bowl was full of fruits and very rich in portion.

Also tries shilajit tea. Special. They sell it as well in their shop. ||| The inner courtyard is quite cozy and quiet, and they have an extensive menu. However, the staff seems completely uninterested in the guests and I didn't feel any friendliness at all. The food tasted ok, and the prices for smoothie bowls and juices are reasonable. Only cash payment. ||| Delicious healthy food, great service, comfortable indoor and outdoor seating. My husband is gluten free and lactose free and this is a great place for allergies. Thank you for some of our best meals in 6 weeks in Nepal. 🙏

address: Pawo Gompa Marg Boudha, Kathmandu 44600, Nepal
reviews:
For sure it’s best place and matcha is AMAZING! Black coffee it’s 10/10 ❤️‍🔥 oat porridge 🥣 also wonderful. Such a lovely place!! ||| Great place to hangout and drink nepali organic coffee & food in a awesome environment. Extraordinary and very unique ambience with locally made crafts and furnitures. Outdoor and cozy feel with the furnitures and materials used. Wide array of delicious menu which changes periodically. ||| Wow, brand new place apparently and what a treat for a California spoiled girl like I.

Fantastic decor, vibe, stuff, healthy food options. We also got their signature detox drink. Very modern and simply pleasant to be in to escape the madness of dusty busy Kathmandu streets.

Coming back here for breakfast! ||| Cute little cafe with a nice and peaceful outdoor area. But they allow smoking which can be annoying in the small space. Food is pretty decent and prices fine. If you visit in summers be aware that there is no AC and you will be hot. ||| The food was fresh and delicious and if you’re looking for something different from Nepalese food, check it out. The coffee also looked very tasty and they have a lot of different options. Definitely catered to tourists so don’t expect a local experience, mostly just Europeans on laptops. They do also have a lot of local goods on sale, all hand made, and are very environmentally conscious.

address: Amitab, Buddha Marg, Tusal 06, Kathmandu 44600, Nepal
reviews:
Very nice place run by very nice people.
The best momos and shable I’ve tried so far and their masala tea is absolutely perfect.
Concept is only fresh food and no MSG! Highly recommend and wish all the luck for this place! ||| Great momos and home made noodles. One of the cleanest kitchens you’ll find in Kathmandu. Friendly staff. The two ladies behind the bar were lovely. Thank you! ||| So delicious! The best momos I’ve had in Nepal. The place is spotlessly clean. The service is warm and friendly, owned by a nice Tibetan family. Would definitely recommend and I will be coming back and bringing friends. ||| Amazing chicken momos ❤️ freshly prepared right in front of you.

The ambiance is perfect and owner is really nice 🙂and nice service.reallly...
Great ambiance and delicious food and beverage. great expenses.🫶💛🍀 ||| Incredible food. Low prices. And most importantly, amazing and friendly staff. The best place for Daal Bhat in Tinchuli/Bouddha. ||| Delicious and great ambiance ||| i love the ambience and service was really nice as well as food was so delicious ||| Delicious and great ambiance

In addition to the indoor seating, there’s also an outdoor area, which is ideal if you prefer to dine with a bit of fresh air. The outdoor setting is peaceful and offers a different experience compared to the indoor ambiance.

Speaking of ambiance, the overall vibe of the place is top-notch and well-maintained. It has the rustic, warm charm that reminds you of Mustang – a place rich in culture and tradition. The décor, combined with the subtle background music, makes for a very relaxing and enjoyable dining experience.

The food was delicious, though I believe there’s still some room for improvement in the overall taste, especially in terms of balance between flavors.

Dalle is a great spot to enjoy flavorful food while spending time at Labim Mall. Whether you’re visiting for shopping or catching a movie at the cinema, Dalle fits perfectly into the overall experience of the mall.

The restaurant has a relaxed and inviting atmosphere, making it a comfortable place to sit down and enjoy a meal. It’s ideal for everything from a quick bite before a movie to a longer hangout with friends or family. The setup is simple but well-organized, and the service is generally smooth even when the mall gets busy.

Food is the highlight here. Dalle is known for its bold flavours and satisfying portions, offering dishes that suit a wide range of tastes. Whether you’re craving something spicy or just a hearty meal, the menu has enough variety to keep things interesting. The quality is consistent, and the presentation is decent for a casual dining spot.

One of the best things about Dalle is its location within Labim Mall. There’s so much to do around — from watching movies at the cinema to exploring shops and enjoying weekend activities in the courtyard. It makes dining here feel like part of a bigger outing rather than just a meal.

After watching a movie, stopping by Dalle for food adds to the experience, and it’s also a good place to relax before heading into a show. The convenience of having good food close to entertainment is a big plus.

Overall, Dalle at Labim Mall is a reliable and enjoyable dining option, perfectly suited to the lively and versatile atmosphere of the mall. ||| Not bad overall. Quick stop inside Labim Mall with easy parking and nice staff @Dalle momo. What impressed us most was the Chop Suey. As Chinese, we’re not very familiar with this dish since it’s known as a Western interpretation of Chinese food, but the version served here was excellent. Fresh vegetables, balanced flavours, and good texture made it memorable — we’d definitely love to try more Chop Suey of this standard in the future.

A great option if you’re in Lapim Mall and want something quick, tasty, and satisfying. ||| Dalle Restaurant located on the 3rd floor of Labim Mall, Pulchowk, Lalitpur is a casual dining spot mainly known for its flavorful momo and spicy touch. The indoor ambience is average and somewhat compact, with around 7–8 tables that seat four people each. During busy hours, it can feel a bit crowded. Tables located closer to the kitchen may experience some smoke and noise, which can be slightly uncomfortable. The space is more suitable for small groups, but they can still manage slightly larger groups by adjusting seating.

The main attraction is their variety of momo, available in veg, chicken, and mutton flavors. While the flavor options are limited to these three, the taste is satisfying and consistent. They also serve rice bowls with chicken, mutton, or vegetarian options, which are convenient and reasonably priced for office lunches. Other menu items include soups, noodles, and egg or chicken dishes, with wonton soup being a recommended option.

As the name suggests, they feature different chili spices, including the famous Dalle chili, which adds a nice kick to the dishes. Soft drinks are available, and they even have a loyalty program for regular customers.

Parking is available at Labim Mall’s paid parking area. They accept cash, cards, and FonePay, and VAT bills are provided. Overall, Dalle is a good quick-stop option for momo lovers inside Labim Mall. ||| Had visited dalle today. It wasn’t as per my expectation. reviews:
Koto Restaurant, located in Pulchowk, Lalitpur, is a cozy and authentic Japanese restaurant offering a wide range of traditional Japanese cuisine. It’s a great place for sushi lovers, especially if you’re visiting in a group—the sushi platter is a must-try, featuring a delicious variety including salmon maki and other flavorful rolls. The prawn tempura roll and sashimi moriawase are fresh and well-prepared.

For those who enjoy noodles, the tempura udon, tanuki udon, and even the cold udon are full of flavor and comforting. If you’re into rice dishes, the oyako don is a great pick. Meat and fish lovers shouldn’t miss the teriyaki, sukiyaki, or grilled salmon steak and rainbow trout—all cooked to perfection.

The ambience is pleasant, and service is good. Prices are affordable, and they accept cash, QR, and card payments, with VAT bills provided. Parking is limited—up to 2 cars or 10 bikes—but overall, Koto is a hidden gem for quality Japanese food in Lalitpur. ||| Firstly the hospitality by the staff is amazing, right after me and my siblings chose a table to sit they provided us with wet towels to wipe our hand and face to feel refreshed.Japanese cuisines are supposed to be expensive so you have to expect a high amount when you look at the bill. The food I ordered was mixed tempura set along with other various kind of dishes. The tempura seemed to have many veggies compared to the meat/fish,the crust of tempura was falling out and had bitter taste of oil. I was really looking forward for the food but frankly I was disappointed.
