I promise, whenever I am in Kathmandu, I will definitely try to visit you place but you will have to make my dish as good as it was today. Many thanks. ||| The staff are friendly and helpful. The food is good - margherita pizza had perfect cheese to dough ratio and tasted good, momo was good, naan was a bit doughy but the curry with it was good, and chicken biryani was also good. Overall, recommended. ||| My first time in Nepal! Great hospitality by the owners who so warmly introduced us to their local cuisine. Enjoyed our momos and khana set very much, so yummy I had second servings. The owners also took time to chat with us and even gave us recommendations on their local food. Thanks so much ☺️ ||| This is my first time in Nepal, and I feel so lucky to have found this restaurant.
From the moment we sat down until the end of our meal, we were treated with such warm hospitality.
They explained and recommended traditional Nepali dishes to us with so much enthusiasm and kindness. Throughout the meal, they kept checking in to make sure we were enjoying everything.
I absolutely loved the last cup of tea, but I forgot its name 😂
Highly recommend this place to everyone!👍

Being our first visit to Nepal and starting at Kathmandu, I wanted to try a Newari Khaja Set before leaving Kathmandu. And this was the place where it happened.

Finding the entrance to this eatry was tricky. Thankfully I saw the main board and the road and then eventually managed to find the stairs going up.

The restaurant itself is quite small. It has interesting decor. Since I was the only one hungry enough to eat a meal, we ended up ordering one Newari Khaja Set (chicken) and two plain Lassi. The Lassi came in around 5 mins and the main meal set in around 20 mins.  The side dishes included in the set are mainly dry items, except for the chicken curry. The pancake that is included is made of lentil, is what I am told by the owner come chef. The Khaja Set is something that I think one needs to get used to, specially if you are not used to eating beaten rice instead of steamed rice and have a tolerance for higher spice level. Not for me I am afraid. The rating is not a reflection of the establishment but rather of my appreciation of the dish.

The service is pleasant and friendly. And like I said, the decor is interesting. ||| My favorite place in Kathmandu. Hidden in one of the tiny street in Thamel, you'll find this cozy and lovely place to have a beautiful Newari tasting.
Manish is gentle and kind, ready to suggest you the best dish and preparing it with care. Focus on details and passionate on cooking.
Don't forget to cheers with the home made Chhyang ("rice beer")! ||| I kind of don’t want to write this review to prevent this restaurant from getting ruined by social media hypes. But this place is lovely. It’s a hidden gem that quite literally deserves that title. You have to look for the little alley with some restaurants just before the corner of the block. The food was so tasteful. We had fried momo’s, chatmari and for dessert yomari chaku. All really good. The owner helped us with choosing beteeen all options for the local dishes and the place is cute and intimite. Only a couple of tables. Definitely recommend. ||| Awesome food. Heads up, it’s a little hard to find- the restaurant is hidden behind another restaurant up a small, narrow staircase.

My dad and I were so glad we didn’t give up trying to find it because we really enjoyed our meal. We ordered several dishes to share, and the flavor was incredible. You can hear the chef making everything fresh in the kitchen, and each bite is bursting with flavor! Great way to taste traditional Newari food at a great price.

And the service was incredible! Very kind and welcoming. Best dining experience we had in Nepal!! ||| My wife found the Thirsty Newari on Google Maps. The reviews looked great, so we decided to try it. We were delighted by our find! The food is delicious and cooked from scratch. The owner/chef was friendly, courteous and attentive. He asked us how spicy we liked our food. I had momo's and spicy potato wedges. My wife had a gluten-free stuffed pancake. The restaurant is very clean. Go and visit... you won't be disappointed! 😀

restaurant_name: Hunger End Thakali Kitchen and Rooftop Restaurant
reviews:
Very nice food both in price and taste. The waitress in the restaurant does not speak English fluently but she will try her best. Even though it is a rooftop restaurant, I strongly recommends against sitting outside as it is near the busy street and the building is not high; therefore very dusty outside and you can smell gasoline. ||| Pros: food taste, atmosphere,
Cons: slight expensive, staffs staring always at us, basin tap water had little space to wash (maybe poorly fit with basin)

But overall, I think that taste matches the price. If you want to go on high quality, neat and slight expensive, it might be perfect for you.  I don't find any major flaws here except the fact that the staffs always staring at us while eating.

Waiting time is decent , not too long , u will get within 10- 30 minutes (depending on your meal)..

Btw, It is not a crowded place. ||| Disgusting food with zero service. We complained about the food, but the staff took no initiative to help or resolve the issue. We were left standing there with no response from anyone. After eating there, I even had a stomach ache. Very disappointing experience. ||| Finally completed my 5 plate of Thali and got 1 free. Just a best vibing and best place to relax at rooftop as well. Best place for Thakali Khana Set and especially Chicken. Went with family and the staff are so friendly as well. My only place for Thakali khana for my family and friends. Highly recommeded. ||| I frequently visit Hunger end and when i visit here my hunger really ends. Affordable price for food and quick service. Sometimes late when a-bit pack but worthy waiting. Taste never disappoints.

restaurant_name: Thulo Thakali Restaurant | Authentic Nepali & Thakali Cuisine
reviews:
Visited Thulo Thakali recently and had a decent experience overall. The food was good and served in reasonable portions, with authentic Thakali flavors. The service was satisfactory, though it could have been a bit quicker during busy hours. The restaurant was clean and the atmosphere was comfortable for a casual meal with family or friends. While nothing particularly stood out, it offers a reliable option for those looking to enjoy traditional Nepali and Thakali cuisine at a fair price. ||| Looked for highly rated Thakali food and discovered this just opposite our hotel.
We ordered the spiced brinjal and corn fry appetiser - they were well seasoned, tasty, well presented. The brinjal can do with a lighter batter (was chewy) though the flavour was on point, with a sweet and spicy bean paste sauce. The corn dish had a wonderful lightly spiced deep taste crunch texture with capsicums, onions and deep fried corn kernels.

Onto the main meal of fish rice, and chicken with puri thakali sets.
The refillable side dishes which included fried spinach, preserved cabbage, deep fried butter gourd, potatoes and black dhall were wonderfully seasoned and tasty. And the included yoghurt complemented the spiced dishes.

The protein mains of fish curry (full unami flavored, deep, though have to be careful of many tiny bones) and chicken curry with its robust flavors cooked interestingly with mung bean noodles, were very tasty too.

Overall, it was a wonderful meal, served by friendly and welcoming staff in a relaxing spartan atmosphere. Lastly, it was a value for $ meal. Fully recommended adding to it's good reviews. ||| Food was spectacular. Ambiance is great. Prices are alright. It's not that expensive. Staff was friendly. I ordered Vegetable soup which was delicious with the touch of Cayenne pepper in it and the next day I tried Egg Thakali which was also a delight. Wish I could try more of the amazing foods but I had less time of stay in Nepal. Although, İ will definitely visit again whenever I come back. 😋 ||| Thulo Thakali is sophisticated, quiet escape for a casual lunch. The Chicken Set and Sekuwa were enjoyable, though perhaps lacking that distinct, punchy depth that standout Thakali experience. While the staff were exceptionally polite and welcoming, the service rhythm was a bit off we found ourselves waiting quite a while to catch someone’s attention for a second order, so a more attentive eye on the table buzzers would definitely elevate the visit. ||| Good thakali option in thamel, the meat was probably one the best i have ever had very tender and soft. Although felt the dining/sitting area somewhat conjusted.

address: Narayanhiti Palace Museum North Gate Rd, Kathmandu 44600, Nepal
reviews:
This place is just too good for the food and hospitality. Their kitchen is open concept to be transparent on their hygiene cooking. Variety of food and Yogurt is best after the meal. My favourite is their draft beer. I just cannot stop drinking even it is winter. Talking about people, they are very lovely and smiley faces. Mutton thali is must where you can get top up again. I will go again if visit KTM. Vinoliva La Vida ||| Vinoliva is my favorite spot Kathmandu. Whether you’re looking for a sophisticated date night, a high-end cocktail at the bar, or late night party with your friends/colleague/family this place delivers. The ambiance is chic yet cozy, and the service is seamless. The bartenders are true artists—the drinks were balanced and unique. It’s the kind of place where you can really lose track of time enjoying great conversation and even better food. ||| Vinoliva Restaurant & Bar is an absolute gem nestled in the heart of Kathmandu. From the moment you step inside, you're greeted with an inviting ambiance that sets the stage for a remarkable dining experience.

The quality of food here is truly exceptional. Each dish is crafted with care and expertise, showcasing the culinary mastery of the chefs. Whether you're craving traditional Nepali flavors or exploring international cuisines, Vinoliva has something to tantalize every palate. The freshness of ingredients and attention to detail shine through in every bite, making each dish a delightful culinary journey.

What sets Vinoliva apart is not just the delicious food, but also the warm hospitality and impeccable service. The staff members are attentive, knowledgeable, and always ready to cater to your needs, ensuring that your dining experience is nothing short of perfection.

One of the standout features of Vinoliva is its spacious and well-maintained parking facility. Finding parking in Kathmandu can often be a challenge, but Vinoliva makes it hassle-free, allowing you to focus on enjoying your meal without any worries.

Moreover, Vinoliva is truly a family-friendly establishment. The welcoming atmosphere and thoughtful amenities make it the perfect place to dine with loved ones of all ages. From high chairs for the little ones to a diverse menu that caters to various dietary preferences, Vinoliva ensures that everyone feels comfortable and satisfied.

Whether you're looking for a romantic dinner for two, a lively gathering with friends, or a memorable family outing, Vinoliva Restaurant & Bar exceeds expectations on every level. With its combination of quality food, excellent service, convenient parking, and family-friendly environment, it's no wonder that Vinoliva is a beloved dining destination in Kathmandu. ||| Went for a lunch buffet here and it was a bang for my buck. Buffet was absolutely worth my money!

Keen to try out their à la carte menu as well for the future.

The service was great as well. Very polite and considerate.

Cool ambiance. They’ve got an indoor and outdoor setting. On-site parking available which makes it very convenient for travel. ||| This is a fantastic spot for an evening out with friends or family. The food is consistently delicious and the drinks are great. The atmosphere is lively and welcoming, and the live band was truly exceptional — they made the night even more enjoyable. The staff were attentive and friendly, providing great service from start to finish. Definitely a place I’d love to come back to!

address: Hotel Yak & Yeti, Durbar Marg, Kathmandu 44600, Nepal
reviews:
The place is absolutely amazing. Quiet and well maintained. You can cozily bask in the sun or opt for comfortable chairs in the restaurant. I would really appreciate if they enhance their coffee experience. For sure, Nepal has much nicer to offer in the coffee segment. ||| The menu online is not updated. Please update it.

For international diners, please note that the dishes are different from usual expectation.

The restaurant has nice atmosphere but the bar top table is too high making the meal slightly unpleasant. There is no other table able to accommodate a group of 8. The restaurant is also too dark, resulting us turning on our torch light to read the menu. Please strike a balance, maybe adding a brighter light to the table, allowing diners to turn up the light when needed.

The restaurant gave 2 free tasty bread based starters which was greatly appreciated. The prawn bisque soup next was amazing, making a great start to the meal. We had an onion soup and russian borscht soup too but both were slightly lacking. The soup should come with the bread instead of after as having soup alone without bread is weird.

Next was the mains, the salmon was average. Grilled pork is amazing. Chicken breast and grilled chicken was average.

The bbq pork ribs was SO bad… it was so dry, tough and flavourless and the fat layer is so thick. This is just not bbq pork ribs from the west as it is named, please rethink the cooking method as its clearly not bbq properly or renaming it as its just misleading. It totally ruined my dining experience as I was looking forward to have a western dish.

Dessert was keylime pie and brownie with ice cream. Both are average. ||| Some restaurants feed you. The Chimney Restaurant at the Yak & Yeti hotel in Kathmandu does something else entirely.

The Yak & Yeti is the former Royal Palace, and the Chimney Restaurant sits in the actual palace kitchen — history in every corner. We loved it so much on our first night in Kathmandu that when we returned after the trek, we went back a second time. And let’s be clear — we came back for the food just as much as the atmosphere. The best momo of the entire trip, an incredible borscht, and honestly you can’t go wrong with anything on the menu.

Our waiter Rabi recognized us immediately and asked how the trek went. Midway through our meal, Chef de Cuisine Rajiv Sapkota came out and spent 20 minutes talking with us about his journey and ours.

Then — completely unprompted — the entire staff emerged from the kitchen with their signature Baked Alaska Sagarmatha. Chocolate writing thanking us for coming and wishing us a safe journey home. A pink dot and a blue dot on the dessert, representing our successful trek to Base Camp.

We didn’t order it. They didn’t ask. They just did it because that’s who they are.

If you’re in Kathmandu, go. Then go back. ||| Our group had a lovely eveing - the food, the service, the atmosphere all mad of a special and wonder night. ||| Recently celebrated a dear friend’s birthday here and it could not have gone better. Entrees (Lamb Shank especially!!) were so tasty and filling, the complimentary focaccia and small cracker appetizer was also a sweet touch. The atmosphere was dimly lit and cozy, while still maintaining elegance and class…perfect for the vibe we were trying to create. Wine was great, cocktails were great, and I was even able to call ahead to order a delicious chocolate cake for the birthday girl. Truly a 10/10 experience, our waitstaff was so kind, helpful and patient. I will definitely be recommending this place to any friends and family seeking a fine dining experience. Thank you for making the evening so special!

Follow this for best dining experiance in Jamal, Kantipath, Kathmandu with free parking facility and lovely Nepal best food. ||| Food is really awsome, taste is like yummy, best place for craving indian cuisine ||| I visited 1st time at earth and flame restaurant, it's very easy to find the restaurant via Google map and believe me food was really awesome and tasty you guys should must visit Tandoori chicken was best ||| The food is amazing! A must-try place. Highly recommended. ||| I visited last week in this restaurant food was really good in taste and ambience also good best indian cuisine taste in town

Love the Food here. Specially the Thakali thali set. The Dal and Curry have a very rich taste. The price is also comparatively preety cheap compared to other Thakali eatery in Nepal. Definitely recommended for anyone who wants to try an authentic Nepalese food experience. ||| I am not a food critics or blogger but the food served to me was superb. Superb lunch. Spacious and clean. We had Perfect thakali lunch. ||| One of the most authentic Thakali restaurant. The ambience is nice and the service is very nice as well. All the staffs are well trained and well mannered. The khana set is super delicious and the dal has the most authentic thakali taste. The price is higher than regular but with that taste and ambience its reasonable. ||| Beautiful decorations and excellent service. The food is pretty good as well although the price is understandably on the higher side. All in all a good place for some tasty thakali dish. ||| Good ambience with spacious seating area. The lights in the ground floor and terrace area really liven up the restaurant. Thakali set was tasty and reasonably priced. I hope they work to bring the charm of Crossroads pokhara into Kathmandu branch as well. Would definitely recommend this place for a good lunch/dinner.

Food was excellent. Service was very good and quick. We had several snacks and so.e fried rice for dinner. the Tinmour Mushrooms were so good we ordered a second plate! ||| If you are looking for a Khana Set at an affordable price, this place is highly recommended. The ambience is pleasant, and the taste of the Khana Set is truly remarkable considering the cost. Although the menu offers a variety of other dishes, I personally visit mainly for the Khana Set, which I enjoy very much ||| Previously I went to this place during lunch time. Had pork sekuwa, chicken sekuwa and Chicken Bento Box. Food was great I must say. But as their slogan goes "Sasto pani, meetho pani", food was not 'Sasto' though.

This time around, I took my child for a meal, proper rice set. Food was good value for money. However, chicken curry felt like "Khaali noon ra pyaaj haalnus, baaki kaam meat masala le garxa". ||| I highly recommend this place to anyone looking for Nepali flavors, quick bite at reasonable price.
One dish that truly stood out for me was this special off the menu dish , (Chicken chatpata) which was perfect blend of spiciness and tanginess. However the sekuwa was very average for a place specialising on sekuwa, momo was juicy and flavourful. The service could be a little prompt but the waiting staff was very helpful and welcoming - give the guy the raise, he deserves it!
Overall, my experience was wonderful and I can’t wait to visit again and try more items from their menu! ||| Really had high hopes looking upon many Instagram posts from multiple food pages. The menu items are very limited, with no proper space for a group of 7+ people. The lower price of certain items comes with lesser quantity which was the main disappointing  factor. Service was really good though and was quick too. Parking for both two and four wheelers is available.

One of the best restaurants in KTM good food, good vibes. Their dim sums and the variety of sushi’s are really good. I had the mushroom bao which for me is one of their best dishes, if your a vegetarian and looking for good dim sums then their crystal mushroom is the one to go for. ||| This used to be one of my favorite restaurants, but I was shocked to see a cockroach crawling out of the sofa during my last visit. It seriously made me question the cleanliness of the place. Unfortunately, I don't think I'll be coming back. ||| We went there with our extended family. This PanAsian restaurant located next to Rising Mall is very well known in Kathmandu for its authentic Asian cuisine, and we had a really great time. The food was amazing. It was served on time, the preparation time was pretty fast, and the service was very prompt. The restaurant was very clean, so everything went well. The food was amazingly tasty, and the only single thing that bothered (for around 5 minutes) us was the food ordered by the family at the table next to ours. They ordered some kind of dish which was prepared in their table and that had burnt chili, which had us all cough and sneeze (including that family). At Other than that, everything went well. ||| The food was delicious. We loved every dish we tried especially the rolls. The service was good. The man who served us was very polite and did his work well. ||| We popped in after a recommendation from my sister who is a regular over here.  We ordered about five different items from the menu, the Prawn tempura was excellent, perfectly battered and hit lips, mouth and throat with warming spices. Dim-sum were seasoned well and great for sharing. The noodles with 3 pepper spices and pork was perfectly cooked. The sushi was really good. Taste and seasonings here were perfectly done. For drinks we took mango mint cooler which was okay. We shared everything and we both liked everything else, especially the service!
Well Done!!

restaurant_name: Piano Piano, Lazimpat - Best Italian Restaurant In Kathmandu
reviews:
I visited alone to enjoy some quiet time with a carbonara, which is a dish I truly love and know well. Sadly, the carbonara here was not good and didn't reflect the rich, authentic taste the dish is known for. This version felt disappointing.

What made the experience more uncomfortable snd sad was the service. The waiter stood right behind me as if waiting for me to finish. The plate was taken away almost instantly after I finished the pasta, even though I still had three pieces of bread left. It felt rushed and not very considerate of the guest's space. ||| A very nice place with good indoor and out door seating space. The lighting the ambiance change the mode after you enter this place. Better then compare to the piano piano in lalitpur, the food service was on point. Tried there Gamberi Aglio E Olio and Ravioli Ai spanach. Both tasted good had flavour and balance. The only down side is the pricing which is on the high side and the food portion is also small but worth it. ||| Piano Piano is easily the finest Italian restaurant in Kathmandu. The food is outstanding, authentic, delicious, and beautifully prepared.

The hospitality is truly exceptional, with staff who are genuinely polite, friendly, and attentive. A must-visit for anyone looking for a memorable Italian dining experience in the city! ||| A Cozy Gem with Delicious Italian Food!

I recently visited Piano Piano and had a wonderful experience! The place is nice and cozy, with a warm and inviting atmosphere. The ambience was great—perfect for a relaxed meal with friends.

The food was delicious, especially their pizza, chicken dishes, and garlic bread—all bursting with delicious flavors. However, the carbonara didn’t quite meet expectations; it lacked the creaminess and depth I was hoping for.

One thing to note is that parking is quite small and might be challenging for cars, but there’s enough space for bikes.

Overall, Piano Piano is a fantastic spot for Italian cuisine in Kathmandu, and I’d definitely recommend it for their amazing pizza and cozy vibe! ||| Very beautiful ambiance. Me and my wife went for our anniversary date and it was such a wonderful experience. Food was very good and the music was soothing and calm. We really had a great time.

Had an amazing dinner here! We saw an ad about the "Great Indian Biryani Trail" happening at Spice Room, where they’re serving biryanis from Kolkata, Hyderabad, and Awadhi. Being huge fans of Kolkata biryani, we couldn’t resist trying it—especially since it’s been years for us, ever since House of Karim closed.

From the very first bite, oh my god—I was completely mesmerized. The flavor, the balance, the simplicity—everything was just perfect. Honestly, words can’t do justice to how good it was. I really wish they’d add Kolkata biryani as a regular dish on the menu so we could keep coming back for it!

The ambiance was lovely, service was excellent, and our server Mahesh was very polite and attentive. To make the experience even sweeter, we were served complimentary  Keshari Rasmalai and Rasbari (a true Kolkata-origin sweet), both of which were delicious. We loved it so much that we even ordered chicken Kolkata biryani to take home.

Overall, such a memorable dining experience—we’ll definitely be back! ||| We stayed here for two days. Hotel services and restaurants are amazing. Food was so delicious. Restaurant staff is so nice. Raj gave us great service at restaurant. Would recommend this Hotel. ||| Had a great evening with warm hospitality and excellent service. Our food requests were thoughtfully honoured. Special thanks to Roji Karki and Abash Karki for making the evening truly memorable. ||| excellent service by Anisha from the moment we entered the restaurant until we left. Malai kofta in creamy mild gravy was delicious - our favourite. Murgh peshawari lababdar and subz seekh numaish were very well tandoored and full of flavour. All these went well with the assorted bread basket. For dessert, lychee chilli mousee was ok. We also ordered chicken biryani as takeaway and it was yum.

I asked the leftover rotis to be packed for home but they were missing when we opened the bag at home. ||| Service was not as expected, felt like eating in a local restaurant where staff brings food and drops at the table and goes, we asked to serve the biryani and the server didn't showed that level of excitement to serve, but the food was good, thanks to chef whoever he/she was.

restaurant_name: Cafe De Tukche Thakali (Lazimpat) - Best Authentic Thakali Restaurant in Town
reviews:
Cafe de Tukche Thakali is one of the most authentic and well-presented Nepali dining experiences in the city. Located in a vibrant and versatile setting, this restaurant goes far beyond just a traditional Thakali set — it offers a complete culinary experience that blends authenticity, variety, and excellent service.

The first impression is the warm and cultural ambience. The interior reflects traditional Nepali aesthetics with a modern touch, creating a comfortable and welcoming atmosphere. It feels like a place where heritage and hospitality come together in a refined way.

While the classic Thakali set is a highlight, the menu offers much more variety than expected. From rich Nepali dishes to other well-prepared items, there is something for every taste. The flavours are well-balanced, and the ingredients feel fresh and thoughtfully prepared. Each dish carries a sense of authenticity, which makes the dining experience more meaningful.

Service at Cafe de Tukche Thakali is another strong point. The staff are attentive, polite, and efficient, ensuring that guests feel well taken care of throughout their visit. Even during busy hours, the service remains smooth and professional.

What makes this place even more enjoyable is its location in a lively, versatile area where there is always something happening around. Whether you are visiting after shopping, meeting friends, or simply looking for a good meal, it fits perfectly into a broader outing experience.

Overall, Cafe de Tukche Thakali stands out as more than just a Thakali restaurant. It offers authenticity, variety, and excellent service in a comfortable setting, making it one of the best places to enjoy Nepali cuisine in a modern dining environment. ||| My wife and I found this restaurant by accident and we are extremely happy we found it. I ordered the vegetarian Thakali because I had never had it before and it was delicious. My wife ended up eating most of my food which very rarely happens. Our waiter Bijay was extremely attentive and had that warm hearted Nepalese smile. We were so impressed we are going to take our friends there with us tomorrow night. We know Bijay will be there again and look forward to his warm welcoming presence. ||| The staff were courteous and welcoming, and the Thakali meal was excellent. All the food items were well prepared and delicious, making it a very satisfying dining experience. ||| If you’re staying in the Lazimpat district of Kathmandu you must visit Cafe de Tukche. The traditional Thakali is delicious with generous portions, but you must try their Momo’s and (Yak) Cheese Balls, they are a taste sensation…!  All the staff are warm,  friendly and welcoming. You won’t be disappointed…! 👍🥂👏 ||| We visited the place for Birthday Dinner.
The foods were good and the service was nice.

Due to the old residential house turned into restaurant, there are separated rooms for various groups having your own privacy.

The seatings are bit odd and old, but overall maintained hygiene and good ambiance makes the place cozy and wonderful for dinner.

Recommended place.

address: The Park, Durbar Marg, Kathmandu 44600, Nepal
reviews:
Had a great experience at Le Mirch. The vibe of the place is warm and welcoming!

The staff was super helpful and attentive throughout our visit, making the experience even better.

The food was absolutely delicious. Every dish was packed with flavour, and the eggplant curry truly stole the show today.

Highly recommend giving this spot a try if you’re craving authentic Indian food done right. ||| Le Mirch at The Park, Durbar Marg is a solid pick if you’re craving Indian food. The flavors were good overall; naan was fresh and satisfying, though the tandoori felt a bit dry.

They also offered a complimentary whiskey-based cocktail, which was a nice touch. I went with my family and we had a good time. If you’re in the area and want Indian food, it’s worth a visit. ||| OMG guys, this place deserves an 11/10! 😭✨
It was raining that night and we were craving Jhol Momo, even though it wasn’t on the menu. But the staff were so kind and accommodating—they actually made it for us, and honestly, it was one of the best Jhol Momos I’ve ever had!
The hospitality was amazing, the food was absolutely worth it, and the best part—it’s halal too. Highly, highly recommended! ||| Excellent Indian food ! Limited menu but whatever is there ...it's excellent ooooooo ! You should see the pictures I have shared all my plates are empty .. it's that delicious.. & the service 100000/100 it's that good ! ||| This restaurant had a lively atmosphere. The food was nice, but there were areas for improvement. The garlic bread was just toast, and the wrap could have been better.

We tried strawberry milkshake and chicken momo both are so delicious thank you so much for your service and the food we will definitely come again ❤️ ||| Food is great so is ambience. Highly recommended |||  |||  |||

Moti Mahal is a great spot for anyone looking for pure vegetarian North Indian food in Kathmandu. The dishes are flavorful and nicely presented, with authentic taste that reminds you of traditional Indian cooking. The restaurant is located in a prime area at Durbar Marg, making it easy to find and convenient to visit. The ambiance is pleasant, and the service is good too. Overall, a solid choice for anyone craving North Indian vegetarian cuisine. ||| Vegetarian and vegan friendly restaurant so many options for vegans ... The only downside is this is a cash only place !!
Portion size are relatively small .. ordered butter naan and it is more like laccha paratha than naan !! There is still some room for improvement. Service was excellent, atmosphere was quite busy. ||| Restaurant was awesome. Service was excellent.  I had Makai roti and sarso ka saag. The food was truly delicious and the serving portion was also good. Recommend for a luxury fine dining experience. ||| Nice veg food. We tried Tandoori Chaap, Tandoori momo, dal fry and gira rice. All items were tasty. 😋👍👏 Hot gulab jamun with ice-cream tried for dessert but it was not good choice. 🍦👎😞 Gulab jamun alone was amazing. 😍👍 Plain lassi was awesome. 💯😋 ||| Added review on 08th Oct 2022
They have added more options. And food has gotten even better with lesser spice quotient than earlier.

If you love Indian veg food, this place is one of the best in Kathmandu to dine-in. Almost everything is good and ambience is super but can get you in a waiting queue during peak hours, better you get your seat reserved before.

Good part is.. all the food we ordered were very very good. Delicious .. Good ambience.
Bad part is... we have to wait a lot for the food to be served even though we were the only ones during the lunch hour.
And they only served HALF egg on the dishes. which was kinda disappointing.
Either way, recommended. ||| I had a sumptuous Thali from this Restaurant.  Clean, delicious and satisfactory. ||| I had an amazing experience at Hungry Sadhu! The food was absolutely delicious, fresh, and full of authentic flavors. The ambiance was cozy and welcoming, making it a perfect place to relax and enjoy a meal. The staff were extremely polite, attentive, and made sure everything was just right. From the presentation to the taste, every detail was impressive. I highly recommend Hungry Sadhu to anyone looking for great food and a wonderful dining experience. Definitely one of the best restaurants around! ||| Loved the ambience and the food!! Perfect for lunch time as they have great offers. Will visit again for sure💖💖💖 ||| Superb for coffee or drinks. The place is in an alley but has a separate cafe n separate restaurant spaces. restaurant_name: Meraki Cafe,Restro & Bar | Restaurant in Thamel, Kathmandu
reviews:
The restaurant is easily labeled to find. Even though the actual restaurant is an alley, a sign points in its direction, making the restaurant very hard to miss when you are looking for it.

Servers were ready to take our order as soon as we made our decisions and quickly got to work, making our orders.

There is a very wide selection of food in this restaurant, as seen in some of the pictures added.

The food came out quickly, relative to other places we have been to nearby. It took about 15 minutes for more simple orders and 20 minutes for complicated orders.

There was an issue with the pizza oven, which delayed my order, but they brought out a complimentary microwave pizza, which still tasted good, while I waited for my actual margherita pizza.

My group members commented on how good their food was, and even the complimentary food I was given tasted great.

The atmosphere is designed like an old building, but with the plants, lights, and music, everything fits together perfectly.
The location of the restaurant prevents customers from constantly hearing honking and cars driving by, further adding to the excellent atmosphere.

Overall, everything was excellent and very worth the cost. ||| Meraki Cafe, Restro & Bar is truly one of the best restaurants in Kathmandu! Located at Narsingh Chowk Marg, just a short walk from Thamel, this place is a must-visit for anyone searching for a top restaurant in Kathmandu with great food, amazing ambiance, and outstanding service.

If you’re looking for the best restaurant in Thamel, Meraki Cafe, Restro & Bar should be at the top of your list. The atmosphere is warm and welcoming, the staff is friendly and attentive, and the menu offers a fantastic variety of delicious dishes and refreshing drinks. Firewood Pizza: I had tried it on my previous visit, and it is worth the hype. It definitely uses a firewood oven because the crust has that smoky flavor and perfect texture. Must try!
​Atmosphere & Experience
This is a big, clean, and spacious cafe; hence, it is very suitable for relaxation. The staff are nice and attentive. The background music is excellent; thus, it creates a lively yet peaceful atmosphere. It's truly a "paradise" amidst the busy city.
